title.zh: AI 基础知识和素养
AI 战略和商业价值创造
title.en: AI Strategy and Business Value Creation

title.zh: AI 治理与负责任的领导力
title.en: AI Governance and Responsible AI Leadership

title.zh: 业务准备、领导力和 AI 转型
title.en: Business Readiness, Leadership, and AI Transformation

rationale.zh: 保留有/无学习证据分类，边界明确且不需背代码
rationale.en: Retain evidence classification with an explicit boundary and no code recall

misconception.zh: 把自动化都当机器学习
misconception.en: Treat all automation as ML

title.zh: AI范围不是是否从样本学习的同义词
title.en: Distinguish broad AI from evidence of learning

brief.zh: 学习目标：AI范围不是是否从样本学习的同义词。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Distinguish broad AI from evidence of learning. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练收集到两条系统描述。按文字是否证明从样本学习分类；这里只判断证据，不判定“是不是全部AI”。
prompt.en: Two exercise system descriptions were collected. Classify whether each establishes learning from examples; do not decide the entire boundary of AI.

text.zh: 有数据学习证据
text.en: Evidence of data learning

text.zh: 未给出数据学习证据
text.en: No data-learning evidence stated

text.zh: 系统从标注订单调整参数
text.en: The system adjusts parameters from labeled orders

text.zh: 系统只执行人工写定的固定审批条件
text.en: The system only executes fixed approval conditions written by people

reason.zh: 固定条件自动执行不必依赖学习；从样本调整参数则提供学习证据。AI是更广领域，未使用ML不能据此排除AI。 回看“学习方式证据收集台”关联知识。
reason.en: Executing fixed conditions need not involve learning; parameter adjustment from examples provides learning evidence. AI is broader, so absence of ML alone does not exclude AI. Revisit the knowledge linked to Learning-method evidence desk.

questions.q: 本演练：评审报告说“采用机器学习，因此不属于AI”。哪条批注正确？
questions.a: 机器学习是AI中的一类方法，报告关系写反
wrong: 报告正确，两个领域互斥
只要是AI就一定使用机器学习

en.q: In this exercise: A review says a system uses ML and therefore is not AI. Which comment is correct?
en.a: ML is one approach within AI; the relationship is wrong
wrong: Correct; the fields exclude each other
Every AI system must use ML

questions.quote: technology that enables computers and machines to simulate human learning, comprehension, problem solving, decision making, creativity and autonomy.

rationale.zh: 原情境要求补证据，已不是定义抄写
rationale.en: The scenario diagnoses evidence gaps rather than copies a definition

misconception.zh: 名称好听就适用
misconception.en: A method name proves suitability

title.zh: 为学习型方案补齐数据、目标和验证
title.en: Specify data, goals and validation for ML

brief.zh: 学习目标：为学习型方案补齐数据、目标和验证。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Specify data, goals and validation for ML. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练：团队希望从历史交易学习异常模式，立项前应补充哪份说明？
prompt.en: In this exercise: The team wants to learn anomaly patterns from transactions. What should be added before approval?

reason.zh: 机器学习依赖数据、目标和验证；方法名称不能证明适用性。 回看“机器学习 ML”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: ML depends on data, goals and evaluation; a method name does not establish suitability. Revisit Machine learning (ML) and check the evidence.

text.zh: 数据、学习目标和独立验证方式
text.en: Data, learning objective and independent evaluation

text.zh: 只写要用机器学习
text.en: Only state that ML will be used

text.zh: 逐条穷举所有交易规则即可证明模型有效
text.en: Exhaustive transaction rules prove model effectiveness

questions.q: 本演练：供应商称其系统为机器学习，但只展示人工编写的逐条阈值。采购方应追问什么？
questions.a: 哪些模式由数据学习，怎样验证目标任务
wrong: 界面是否写了AI两个字
阈值越多是否就自动成为机器学习

en.q: In this exercise: A vendor calls its system ML but shows only manually written thresholds. What should procurement ask?
en.a: Which patterns are learned from data and how the target task is evaluated
wrong: Whether the interface says AI
Whether more thresholds automatically make ML

questions.quote: all machine learning is AI, but not all AI is machine learning.

rationale.zh: 旧题近似重现定义与引导；改判断材料不能证明什么
rationale.en: Replace definition-like repetition with limits of incomplete evidence

misconception.zh: 宣传深度即可确认DL
misconception.en: Deep marketing proves DL

title.zh: 架构证据缺失时不冒认DL
title.en: Do not assert DL without architectural evidence

brief.zh: 学习目标：架构证据缺失时不冒认DL。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Do not assert DL without architectural evidence. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 供应商材料说：系统从历史样本更新参数，并能产生预测。宣传页写着“深度智能”，但没有计算节点、连接或网络层结构说明。评审现在可以支持哪些判断和后续要求？不要把未提供的架构当成已知。
prompt.en: A supplier says its system updates parameters from historical examples and produces predictions. Marketing calls it deep intelligence, but provides no computational-node, connection or network-layer description. Which judgments and requests are supported now? Do not treat missing architecture as known.

reason.zh: 从样本调整参数支持学习型方法的描述，不自动证明多层神经网络；“深度智能”是宣传词，缺架构应保留未知而非肯定或否定DL。回看“深度学习、神经网络”。
reason.en: Parameter adjustment from examples supports a learning-based description, not automatically a multilayer neural network. Marketing is not architecture; preserve uncertainty rather than affirm or deny DL without evidence. Revisit Deep learning and Neural networks.

text.zh: 宣传出现“深度”就证明使用多层神经网络
text.en: The word deep in marketing proves a multilayer neural network

text.zh: 要求补充可核验的模型结构资料，再判断是否符合DL特征
text.en: Request verifiable model-architecture material before judging DL characteristics

text.zh: 已有数据学习的描述，但现有材料不足以确认深度学习
text.en: There is a description of data learning, but insufficient material to confirm deep learning

text.zh: 能产生预测就证明DL不属于ML
text.en: Producing predictions proves DL is outside ML

questions.q: 本演练：教材草图把AI、ML、DL画成互不重叠的三块。怎样修改？
questions.a: 把深度学习放入机器学习范围，再把机器学习放入AI范围
wrong: 把AI放入深度学习范围
保留互斥，因为名字不同

en.q: In this exercise: A draft draws AI, ML and DL as disjoint blocks. How should it change?
en.a: Place DL within ML and ML within AI
wrong: Place AI within DL
Keep them disjoint because names differ

questions.quote: Deep learning is a subset of machine learning driven by multilayered neural networks

rationale.zh: 原排序照题面箭头；改查真实结构证据
rationale.en: Arrow copying becomes architectural evidence evaluation

misconception.zh: 画三个框就是神经网络
misconception.en: Three boxes prove a neural network

title.zh: 辨认可学习连接计算结构

brief.zh: 学习目标：辨认可学习连接计算结构。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Recognize learnable connected computation. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 技术评审收到三项材料。哪些材料能支持“这里确实有神经网络计算结构”，而不只是把界面画成三个方框？选择全部有用的结构证据。
prompt.en: Reviewers receive three materials. Which support an actual neural-network computation structure rather than three boxes drawn in an interface? Select all useful architectural evidence.

reason.zh: 节点计算、连接和可学习权重是结构证据；三个标题只描述界面，不证明模型结构。能区分结构与示意图才算理解，不能靠沿已画好的箭头照排。回看“神经网络”。
reason.en: Node computations, connections and learnable weights are architectural evidence. Three headings describe an interface, not a model structure. Revisit Neural networks.

text.zh: 输入如何经过相连节点的计算传到结果的记录
text.en: A trace of how input propagates through connected-node computations to the result

text.zh: 界面上只有“输入、处理、输出”三个标题
text.en: Only interface headings saying input, process and output

text.zh: 计算节点之间的连接以及各连接使用的可学习权重
text.en: Connections among computational nodes and the learnable weights used by those connections

questions.q: 本演练：某模型说明只写“相连计算节点”，遗漏了学习机制的关键组成。应补什么？
questions.a: 节点连接中的可学习权重
wrong: 保证永远正确的人工常识
必须由人逐次批准的固定节点答案

en.q: In this exercise: A model description lists connected computational nodes but omits a key learning component. What is missing?
en.a: Learnable weights in the connections
wrong: Human common sense guaranteeing correctness
Fixed node answers manually approved every time

questions.quote: stacks simple "neurons" in layers and learns pattern-recognizing weights and biases from data to map inputs to outputs.

rationale.zh: 分类需要看业务结果而非输入代码，保留
rationale.en: Retain routing by business output rather than codes

misconception.zh: 按部门名猜方法
misconception.en: Guess methods from departments

title.zh: 按语言任务输出分流
title.en: Route language tasks by their output

brief.zh: 学习目标：按语言任务输出分流。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Route language tasks by their output. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练工单台收到三项任务，把任务送到分类、抽取或翻译窗口。
prompt.en: The exercise ticket desk receives three tasks. Route each to classification, extraction or translation.

text.zh: 分类
text.en: Classification

text.zh: 抽取
text.en: Extraction

text.zh: 翻译
text.en: Translation

text.zh: 判断工单属于退货还是咨询
text.en: Decide whether a ticket concerns a return or inquiry

text.zh: 从正文找出订单编号
text.en: Locate the order identifier in prose

text.zh: 把客户留言转为另一种语言
text.en: Render a customer message in another language

reason.zh: 任务分别要求类别、原文要素和跨语言表达，都是处理人类语言的任务；窗口名字不能代替实际输出核验。 回看“语言任务分流台”关联知识。
reason.en: The outputs are a category, a source element and another-language rendering. All process human language, while window labels do not replace output verification. Revisit the knowledge linked to Language-task routing desk.

questions.q: 本演练：项目要把多语言用户评论翻译并分类，而不是生成图片。哪项立项描述准确？
questions.a: 处理人类语言的NLP任务
wrong: 只能属于视频空间定位
有多语言就不需要验证分类任务

en.q: In this exercise: A project translates and classifies multilingual reviews rather than generating pictures. Which description fits?
en.a: NLP tasks processing human language
wrong: Only video spatial localization
Multiple languages remove the need for classification evaluation

questions.quote: NLP tools can automatically classify, extract key information and summarize content

rationale.zh: 现题要求任务判断，保留
rationale.en: Retain the task-specific judgment

misconception.zh: 所有AI都生成文本
misconception.en: All AI generates text

title.zh: 依据图像任务识别视觉需求
title.en: Identify visual tasks from image requirements

brief.zh: 学习目标：依据图像任务识别视觉需求。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Identify visual tasks from image requirements. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练：产线要从照片中定位瑕疵，应该选择哪种输入与任务描述？
prompt.en: In this exercise: A production line wants to locate defects in photos. Which input-task description fits?

reason.zh: 照片与空间位置是视觉任务的依据，不能把所有AI任务都理解为文本生成。 回看“计算机视觉 CV”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Photos and spatial locations motivate vision; AI tasks are not all text generation. Revisit Computer vision and check the evidence.

text.zh: 仅按固定金额审批
text.en: Approve solely by a fixed amount

text.zh: 翻译客服工单正文
text.en: Translate ticket text

text.zh: 从图像提取并解释瑕疵位置
text.en: Extract and interpret defect locations from images

questions.q: 本演练：仓库希望解释监控视频里箱子的位置变化。哪项需求描述避免技术错配？
questions.a: 从视频提取并解释视觉信息
wrong: 只把视频文件名当自然语言分类
视频任务必然不属于AI

en.q: In this exercise: A warehouse wants to interpret changing box locations in video. Which description avoids a mismatch?
en.a: Extract and interpret visual information from video
wrong: Only classify video filenames as text
Video tasks cannot be AI

questions.quote: process, analyze and interpret visual inputs such as images and videos.

rationale.zh: 事实核验判断有明确误区，保留
rationale.en: Retain the grounded verification decision

misconception.zh: 流畅即真实
misconception.en: Fluency establishes truth

title.zh: 核验生成内容而不依赖流畅度

brief.zh: 学习目标：核验生成内容而不依赖流畅度。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Verify generated content beyond fluency. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练：模型写出流畅访谈摘要，负责人尚未核对。下一步应是什么？
prompt.en: In this exercise: The model writes a fluent interview summary that has not been checked. What comes next?

reason.zh: 流畅性不能证明事实正确，复核源文才能发现遗漏与误解。 回看“生成式人工智能 GenAI”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Fluency does not establish truth; source comparison exposes omissions and misunderstandings. Revisit Generative AI (GenAI) and check the evidence.

text.zh: 因语言流畅直接发布
text.en: Publish because it is fluent

text.zh: 对照原文核实事实、遗漏和适用性
text.en: Check facts, omissions and applicability against the source

text.zh: 只增加漂亮措辞作为事实验证
text.en: Use polished wording as factual validation

questions.q: 本演练：生成的产品说明写出原资料没有的认证，文风很自然。应怎样处理？
questions.a: 标记为未获支持并核实后再使用
wrong: 自然语言足够流畅就保留认证
只换一种语气即可证明认证

en.q: In this exercise: Generated product copy includes a certification absent from the source but sounds natural. What should happen?
en.a: Flag the unsupported claim and verify before use
wrong: Keep it because the wording is fluent
A tone change proves the certification

questions.quote: technology that enables computers and machines to simulate human learning, comprehension, problem solving, decision making, creativity and autonomy.

rationale.zh: 原题完整交代箭头链；改为目标驱动步骤搭建
rationale.en: Replace supplied order with goal-driven procedure construction

misconception.zh: 记住顺序等于理解算法
misconception.en: Remembering an order equals understanding algorithms

title.zh: 构造可执行方法

brief.zh: 学习目标：构造可执行方法。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Construct an executable method. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 门店要给本批金额最高的一笔订单加“优先复核”标记。资料还没读入，最高金额也未知。把这些可执行工作卡连接成能完成任务的方法；卡片的前一步必须产生后一步要用的信息。
prompt.en: A store must mark the highest-value order in this batch for priority review. The records have not been read and the highest value is unknown. Connect executable work cards so each step produces information used by the next.

reason.zh: 找最大值要先取得记录，写标记又要先确定订单。能按信息依赖构造方法，才是理解算法；不是照抄一条已给出的箭头链。回看“算法”。
reason.en: Finding a maximum needs the records; marking needs the identified order. Constructing the information dependencies demonstrates an executable method. Revisit Algorithm.

text.zh: 给找到的订单写入优先复核标记
text.en: Mark that identified order for priority review

text.zh: 从读入记录中找到最高金额订单
text.en: Find the highest-value order in the read records

text.zh: 读取本批订单与金额
text.en: Read this batch of orders and amounts

questions.q: 本演练：团队保存了训练步骤说明和训练后的参数文件，交接时哪个是算法说明？
questions.a: 训练步骤说明
wrong: 训练后的参数文件本身
二者没有任何角色区别

en.q: In this exercise: A team keeps training-step instructions and a trained parameter file. Which is the algorithm description?
en.a: The training-step instructions
wrong: The trained parameter file itself
There is no role distinction

questions.quote: A clearly specified mathematical process for computation; a set of rules that, if followed, will give a prescribed result.

rationale.zh: 删除history/forecast抄码，改为业务职责分类
rationale.en: Remove history/forecast transcription; classify functional roles

misconception.zh: 估计就是观察事实
misconception.en: Estimates are observed facts

title.zh: 区分业务输入、估计输出与下游行动
title.en: Separate inputs, estimates and downstream actions

brief.zh: 学习目标：区分业务输入、估计输出与下游行动。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Separate inputs, estimates and downstream actions. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 维修中心用模型预估设备何时需要检查。中心先测得振动和温度，模型给出预计剩余运行小时，调度员再决定哪台先检修。把三份材料放进各自职责区，不用输入任何英文代码。
prompt.en: A maintenance center uses a model to estimate when equipment needs inspection. It measures vibration and temperature; the model estimates remaining operating hours; a dispatcher decides inspection priority. Place each material in its functional area; no code entry is needed.

reason.zh: 输入来自待处理业务的测量，输出是模型给出的估计；人员据此安排工作仍是下游行动。把行动当成模型输入，或把估计当成已观察事实，都会混淆职责。回看“模型”。
reason.en: Inputs are measurements from the current task; outputs are estimates; human scheduling is downstream action. An estimate is not an observed fact, and an action is not the model input here. Revisit Model.

text.zh: 业务提供给模型的资料
text.en: Business information supplied to the model

text.zh: 模型产生的估计
text.en: Estimate produced by the model

text.zh: 人员使用结果作出的行动
text.en: Human action using the result

text.zh: 本次温度与振动测量值
text.en: Current temperature and vibration measurements

text.zh: 还可运行约18小时的估计
text.en: An estimate of about 18 operating hours remaining

text.zh: 把设备排入明早检修队列
text.en: Schedule the device for inspection tomorrow morning

questions.q: 本演练：模型能输出信用估计，团队却没定义估计是否有用。验收缺少什么？
questions.a: 根据任务目标验证输出的标准
wrong: 只检查模型文件存在的清单
把所有输出自动当成正确事实

en.q: In this exercise: A model emits credit estimates but the team has not defined usefulness. What is missing?
en.a: Criteria evaluating outputs against the task goal
wrong: Only an inventory proving the model file exists
Automatically treating all outputs as correct facts

questions.quote: all machine learning is AI, but not all AI is machine learning.

rationale.zh: 照排已给验收路径不能证明理解；改判断和依据两轮
rationale.en: Replace copied evaluation order with judgment and evidence

misconception.zh: 训练高分保证新样本
misconception.en: Training scores guarantee new cases

title.zh: 用参数变化识别训练并独立验证
title.en: Identify training by parameter change and validate independently

brief.zh: 学习目标：用参数变化识别训练并独立验证。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Identify training by parameter change and validate independently. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 语音团队记录两项工作：甲反复比较旧录音的预测与人工结果，把差异用于改变连接权重；乙锁定刚保存的权重，为一段新录音给出文字。按记录勾选各工作实际发生的事情，不根据“新结果”三个字判断。
prompt.en: A speech team records two jobs. Job A repeatedly compares predictions on old recordings with human outcomes and uses the differences to change connection weights. Job B locks the saved weights and produces text for a new recording. Mark what actually happens in each job rather than judging from the phrase new result.

reason.zh: 甲的关键是参数改变；乙只使用已有参数。训练分数仍不能证明未见录音也可靠。把产生新文字误当参数学习，说明没分清训练和运行。回看“训练、推理”。
reason.en: Job A changes parameters; Job B uses existing ones. Training scores still do not establish reliability on unseen recordings. New text does not imply parameter learning. Revisit Training and Inference.

text.zh: 甲：利用差异改变权重
text.en: A: changes weights using differences

text.zh: 乙：锁定权重处理新录音
text.en: B: processes new audio with locked weights

text.zh: 本次参数发生学习调整
text.en: Parameters are adjusted through learning

text.zh: 以已有参数处理这次新输入
text.en: Existing parameters process this new input

prompt.zh: 甲在旧录音上全部识别正确。现在要证明它能处理另一家门店的新录音，还缺哪项证据？
prompt.en: Job A recognizes all old recordings correctly. What is still needed to support use on a different store’s new recordings?

reason.zh: 训练证据和泛化证据不能互相代替；独立样本必须未参与本次学习。回看“训练”。
reason.en: Training evidence and generalization evidence are distinct; independent cases must not have participated in fitting. Revisit Training.

text.zh: 再展示一次旧录音高分
text.en: Show the old-recording score again

text.zh: 把新录音答案加入参数调整再称独立检验
text.en: Use the new answers for fitting and call the result independent

text.zh: 用未参与参数调整、符合新用途的独立录音检验
text.en: Evaluate independent recordings not used for parameter fitting and relevant to the new use

questions.q: 本演练：日志显示系统反复利用样本调整权重，产品经理把它标成普通在线回答。应如何诊断？
questions.a: 这是训练过程，且仍需独立验证效果
wrong: 只要运行在服务器就一定是推理
参数调整自动证明新数据一定正确

en.q: In this exercise: Logs show repeated weight updates from examples, labeled as ordinary live answering. How should this be diagnosed?
en.a: It is training and still needs independent evaluation
wrong: Anything on a server is inference
Parameter updates prove all new-data outputs correct

questions.quote: In machine learning, learning involves adjusting the parameters of an ML model.

rationale.zh: 原两项近似定义配对；改三种新日志
rationale.en: Replace two definition-like items with three new logs

misconception.zh: 新文字意味着训练
misconception.en: New text means training

title.zh: 用参数证据判断推理并保留未知
title.en: Identify inference from parameter evidence and retain uncertainty

brief.zh: 学习目标：用参数证据判断推理并保留未知。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Identify inference from parameter evidence and retain uncertainty. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 在线翻译服务出现三段日志：一次运行冻结参数处理刚上传的段落；另一次后台用纠错样本改变模型权重；第三段只写“结果变了”，没有参数记录。按证据能支持的结论归类。
prompt.en: An online translator has three logs: one freezes parameters and processes a newly uploaded paragraph; another changes weights using corrected examples; a third merely says the result changed, with no parameter trace. Classify only what the evidence supports.

reason.zh: 推理看是否使用已有参数，训练看是否发生学习调整；结果不同本身不足以断言训练。第三项应保留不确定性，不能按“新输出”猜。回看“推理”。
reason.en: Inference uses existing parameters; training adjusts them through learning. Different results alone do not prove training, so preserve uncertainty for the third log. Revisit Inference.

text.zh: 使用已有模型的推理
text.en: Inference using an existing model

text.zh: 改变模型的训练
text.en: Training that changes the model

text.zh: 证据不足以区分
text.en: Insufficient evidence to distinguish

text.zh: 参数文件未写入，对新段落产生译文
text.en: No parameter writes; a translation is produced for a new paragraph

text.zh: 纠错误差用于更新权重并保存新参数
text.en: Correction errors update weights and save new parameters

text.zh: 只记录两次结果不同，没有参数变化信息
text.en: Only different results are recorded, with no parameter-change information

questions.q: 本演练：用户误以为每次向模型提问都会更新参数；本演练明确参数冻结。哪条说明正确？
questions.a: 该请求使用已有参数产生输出，是推理
wrong: 每条请求都必然训练模型
冻结参数意味着无法产生任何输出

en.q: In this exercise: A user thinks each question updates weights; parameters are explicitly frozen here. Which explanation is correct?
en.a: This request uses existing parameters to produce an output: inference
wrong: Every request necessarily trains the model
Frozen parameters prevent all outputs

questions.quote: AI inference is the act of using a trained AI model to make predictions on new data.

rationale.zh: 计算保留；承认仅计算不能独立证明业务后果，正式题补测
rationale.en: Retain arithmetic with explicit limits and separate consequence assessment

misconception.zh: 误差相同后果就相同
misconception.en: Equal errors imply equal impact

title.zh: 计算预测差额并区分后果
title.en: Calculate prediction differences and distinguish impacts

brief.zh: 学习目标：计算预测差额并区分后果。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Calculate prediction differences and distinguish impacts. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练只有两笔补货判断：A预测备货80、实际需求100；B预测备货120、实际需求100。不计期初库存。填写A缺货量和B多备量，单位件；不能只因误差相同就宣称业务后果相同。
prompt.en: Exercise: A stocks a forecast 80 units with actual demand 100; B stocks a forecast 120 with demand 100. Initial stock is zero. Enter A shortage and B excess in units; equal errors do not establish equal consequences.

reason.zh: 100−80=20件缺货；120−100=20件多备。绝对差额相同，但缺货与积压的业务后果需分别评估，题面未给损失金额不能编造。 回看“预测后果计算尺”关联知识。
reason.en: 100−80=20 units short; 120−100=20 units excess. Equal absolute errors can have different business consequences. No loss prices are given, so do not invent them. Revisit the knowledge linked to Prediction-consequence calculator.

questions.q: 本演练：库存经理只提交平均预测误差，没有说明高估与低估的后果。评审应补什么？
questions.a: 分别分析积压与缺货等错误后果
wrong: 误差是数值所以无需业务解释
所有预测都应被当成确定承诺

en.q: In this exercise: An inventory manager reports average forecast error without over/underestimate consequences. What should review add?
en.a: Analyze consequences such as excess stock and shortages separately
wrong: Numeric error needs no business interpretation
All predictions should be certain commitments

questions.quote: AI inference is the act of using a trained AI model to make predictions on new data.

rationale.zh: 按样本内容判断而非输入标签代码，保留
rationale.en: Retain record-content judgments, not code input

misconception.zh: 有数据就有监督目标
misconception.en: Any data has a supervised target

title.zh: 核查本任务目标标签

brief.zh: 学习目标：核查本任务目标标签。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Check task-specific target labels. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练要学习输入→欺诈标签映射。分拣是否已具备该任务的目标标签；不判断资料是否足够或质量是否合格。
prompt.en: The exercise task learns inputs→fraud labels. Sort records by whether that task target is present; do not infer sufficiency or quality.

text.zh: 已有本任务目标标签
text.en: Has this task target label

text.zh: 尚无本任务目标标签
text.en: Lacks this task target label

text.zh: 交易特征与已核实欺诈/正常标签
text.en: Transaction features with verified fraud/legitimate labels

text.zh: 交易特征但没有欺诈结果
text.en: Transaction features without fraud outcomes

reason.zh: 监督映射需要本任务目标标签；有特征不等于已有标签，有标签也不自动证明代表性或泛化。 回看“监督学习样本分拣台”关联知识。
reason.en: Supervised mapping needs the task target. Features alone are not labels, while labels alone do not establish representativeness or generalization. Revisit the knowledge linked to Supervised-example sorting desk.

questions.q: 本演练：房价样本包含房屋特征和已成交价格，学习目标是估计新房价格。哪项理由支持监督学习？
questions.a: 已有目标价格标签，学习输入到目标映射
wrong: 价格是数值所以不能监督学习
存在特征就一定没有目标标签

en.q: In this exercise: House records have features and sale prices, and the goal is new-price estimates. What supports supervised learning?
en.a: Target price labels enable learning an input-target mapping
wrong: Numeric targets prevent supervised learning
Features imply there are no target labels

questions.quote: Supervised learning is a machine learning technique that uses labeled data sets to train artificial intelligence

rationale.zh: 题意含方法选择与结论边界，保留
rationale.en: Retain method choice and conclusion limits

misconception.zh: 聚类天然等于业务真相
misconception.en: Clusters automatically equal business truth

title.zh: 探索无目标标签结构而不当结论

brief.zh: 学习目标：探索无目标标签结构而不当结论。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Explore unlabeled structure without overclaiming. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练：没有预设客户类别标签，希望按购买特征找相似群体。应如何安排？
prompt.en: In this exercise: There are no predefined customer labels; the team wants groups by purchasing patterns. What fits?

reason.zh: 无标签可以探索结构，但找到分群不等于自动证明业务含义。 回看“无监督学习”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Unlabeled data supports structure exploration; clusters do not automatically establish business meaning. Revisit Unsupervised learning and check the evidence.

text.zh: 评估无监督聚类，并解释找到的结构
text.en: Evaluate unsupervised clustering and interpret the structure

text.zh: 先把不存在的类别答案当真值
text.en: Treat nonexistent category answers as ground truth

text.zh: 把每个分群当成已验证业务结论
text.en: Treat every cluster as a verified business conclusion

questions.q: 本演练：分析师声称无标签分群已经验证了“高价值客户”真值。评审应指出什么？
questions.a: 分群发现结构，不等于拥有目标真值
wrong: 无标签数据不能包含任何结构
每个聚类名称自动成为真实标签

en.q: In this exercise: An analyst claims unlabeled clusters verify high-value-customer ground truth. What should review note?
en.a: Clustering finds structure; it does not supply target ground truth
wrong: Unlabeled data cannot contain structure
Every cluster name automatically becomes a true label

questions.quote: analyze and cluster unlabeled data sets. These algorithms discover hidden patterns or data groupings

rationale.zh: 原题照排明示循环；改计算加依据
rationale.en: Replace a supplied loop with arithmetic and rationale

misconception.zh: 第一轮最好就长期最好
misconception.en: Best first reward means best long-term policy

title.zh: 以累计回报评价行动策略

brief.zh: 学习目标：以累计回报评价行动策略。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Evaluate policies by cumulative return. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 机器人演练比较两条策略的两轮奖励，不折扣也不设其他收益。甲得到6、−4；乙得到2、3。填写各策略两轮累计回报，不用第一轮大小代替整段表现。
prompt.en: A robot exercise compares two policies over two reward rounds, with no discounting or other gains. A receives 6 and −4; B receives 2 and 3. Enter each cumulative return rather than choosing from the first round alone.

reason.zh: 甲6−4=2，乙2+3=5；奖励反馈要结合后续结果。数值只属于本演练，不是所有强化学习的回报定义。回看“强化学习”。
reason.en: A: 6−4=2; B: 2+3=5. Reward feedback must include subsequent outcomes. These numbers and the no-discount assumption apply only to this exercise. Revisit Reinforcement learning.

prompt.zh: 该演练还有一种做法：只挑第一轮奖励最大的策略，并完全忽略后续回报。为什么证据不足？
prompt.en: Another approach picks whichever policy has the largest first reward and ignores later return. Why is this insufficient in the exercise?

reason.zh: 能解释第一轮与累计回报的差别，才不只是算一次加法。回看“强化学习”。
reason.en: Explaining immediate versus cumulative reward distinguishes understanding from arithmetic alone. Revisit Reinforcement learning.

text.zh: 行动策略应以给定时段累计回报比较，第一轮较高可能随后受损
text.en: Policies should be compared by the stated cumulative return; a high first reward can be followed by loss

text.zh: 奖励只是人工类别标签，与环境行动无关
text.en: Rewards are just category labels unrelated to environmental actions

text.zh: 只要有奖励就能保证长期最好
text.en: Any reward guarantees the best long-term policy

questions.q: 本演练：两个策略当天奖励相同，但后续库存表现不同。按强化学习目标应关注什么？
questions.a: 长期累计回报，而非只看当天
wrong: 永远只比较第一步奖励
忽略环境交互，只统计标签数量

en.q: In this exercise: Two policies earn equal rewards today but differ in later inventory outcomes. What should the RL objective consider?
en.a: Cumulative return rather than today alone
wrong: Always compare only the first reward
Ignore interactions and only count labels

questions.quote: The agent’s only objective is to maximize its cumulative rewards from the environment.

rationale.zh: 原边界分类有效，保留
rationale.en: Retain the structure-versus-content distinction

misconception.zh: 表格不会错
misconception.en: Tables cannot be wrong

title.zh: 把结构与事实准确分开

brief.zh: 学习目标：把结构与事实准确分开。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Separate schema from value accuracy. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练：把每项观察或任务放入对应类别。
prompt.en: In this exercise: put each observation or task in its matching category.

reason.zh: 结构与准确性是两个维度；统一字段不能修正录入错误。 回看“结构化数据”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Structure and accuracy are separate; consistent fields do not correct entry errors. Revisit Structured data and check the evidence.

text.zh: 结构说明
text.en: Structure statement

text.zh: 还需核验的内容
text.en: Values needing checks

text.zh: 表含固定日期与数量字段
text.en: Table has fixed date and quantity fields

text.zh: 订单数量是否录入准确
text.en: Whether order quantities were entered accurately

questions.q: 本演练：数据团队把订单正文整理为固定字段，但发现商品编号录错。哪条验收判断正确？
questions.a: 结构化完成不等于内容准确，仍需修正编号
wrong: 有统一字段就必须判定数据准确
录错一个值就证明根本没有字段结构

en.q: In this exercise: Order prose is converted to fixed fields, but product IDs are incorrect. Which acceptance judgment is correct?
en.a: Structuring is not accuracy; IDs still need correction
wrong: Uniform fields require passing accuracy
One incorrect value proves there is no field structure

questions.quote: Structured data has a strict, predefined data model. Unstructured data does not have a predefined format.

rationale.zh: 场景处理路线可保留，不按名称机械收集
rationale.en: Retain functional processing routes rather than mechanical collection

misconception.zh: 非结构化无法使用
misconception.en: Unstructured data is unusable

title.zh: 按用途提取组织非结构化信息

brief.zh: 学习目标：按用途提取组织非结构化信息。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Extract and organize unstructured information. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练要按统一订单字段统计。将原料分为可直接读固定字段与需先提取组织；不评价内容是否准确。
prompt.en: The exercise aggregates consistent order fields. Sort sources into fixed-field reading or extraction and organization first, without judging accuracy.

text.zh: 可读取既定字段
text.en: Read predefined fields

text.zh: 先提取与组织信息
text.en: Extract and organize first

text.zh: 固定日期/商品/数量的订单表
text.en: An order table with fixed date/product/quantity fields

text.zh: 客户来电录音
text.en: A customer call recording

text.zh: 客户访谈正文
text.en: Customer interview prose

reason.zh: 录音和正文没有直接提供本任务所需固定字段，需要提取组织。非结构化不是没有信息，表结构也不保证内容准确。 回看“非结构化资料收集与分流”关联知识。
reason.en: Audio and prose do not directly provide the task’s fixed fields and need extraction and organization. Unstructured does not mean uninformative, and table structure does not guarantee accuracy. Revisit the knowledge linked to Unstructured-source collection and routing.

questions.q: 本演练：扫描图片与录音里有客户信息，业务方认为没有表格就没有可用信息。如何回应？
questions.a: 先提取与用途有关的信息，再组织使用
wrong: 非结构化就等于信息为空
直接假设所有录音都有固定日期字段

en.q: In this exercise: Scans and audio contain customer information, but the business says no table means no usable information. How should you respond?
en.a: Extract task-relevant information and organize it
wrong: Unstructured means empty information
Assume all recordings have fixed date fields

questions.quote: Structured data has a strict, predefined data model. Unstructured data does not have a predefined format.

rationale.zh: 删除fresh/complete等代码抄写，改实算与证据决策
rationale.en: Remove diagnostic-code transcription; calculate and decide from evidence

misconception.zh: 大模型补齐一切质量
misconception.en: A bigger model repairs all quality

title.zh: 按用途核验并修复质量
title.en: Check and repair fitness for use

brief.zh: 学习目标：按用途核验并修复质量。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Check and repair fitness for use. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练用于按订单统计收入。负责人已核实两条B记录是同一笔订单被重复导入，其他记录各是一笔：A=50，B=70，B=70，C=90。修复统计结果，填写真实订单数和收入合计。
prompt.en: This exercise reports revenue by order. The owner has verified the two B rows are one order imported twice; the other rows are distinct: A=50, B=70, B=70, C=90. Repair the order count and revenue total.

reason.zh: B只能计一次，因此3笔、50+70+90=210。只是字段齐全不能证明内容适用，去重须有负责人核实依据。回看“数据质量”。
reason.en: Count verified duplicate B once: three orders and 50+70+90=210. Complete fields do not guarantee fitness; deduplication requires evidence. Revisit Data quality.

prompt.zh: 另一份材料金额缺失且日期早于当前用途要求。负责人要求立刻给出可靠总额。选择仍需处理的全部事项。
prompt.en: Another source has missing amounts and is older than the use requires. The owner requests a reliable total immediately. Select every issue still requiring action.

reason.zh: 完整性和时效性都要按用途核查；已修一个重复问题不代表所有质量问题消失。回看“数据质量”。
reason.en: Check completeness and freshness against the use; fixing duplication does not resolve every quality issue. Revisit Data quality.

text.zh: 补核缺失金额，不能凭模型猜成已知
text.en: Verify missing amounts rather than treat model guesses as known

text.zh: 核对资料时效是否满足用途
text.en: Check whether freshness meets the use

text.zh: 记录是表格，所以直接宣布可靠
text.en: The records are tabular, so declare them reliable

questions.q: 本演练：销量记录齐全且格式一致，但都来自过期产品。能仅凭完整性通过当前需求分析验收吗？
questions.a: 不能，还需检查时效性和与用途的相关性
wrong: 能，完整性代替所有质量维度
能，只要换一个大模型

en.q: In this exercise: Sales records are complete and consistent but concern obsolete products. Is completeness sufficient for current demand analysis?
en.a: No; freshness and relevance to the use also matter
wrong: Yes; completeness replaces every quality dimension
Yes, provided a larger model is used

questions.quote: accuracy, completeness, validity, consistency, uniqueness, timeliness and fitness for purpose

rationale.zh: 旧题与引导同问需要独立样本；改查真实使用记录
rationale.en: Replace a repeated call for independent cases with a data-use audit

misconception.zh: 新环境记录参与学习也能算独立
misconception.en: New-environment fitting records count as independent evaluation

title.zh: 从数据使用记录判断泛化证据范围
title.en: Judge generalization evidence from data-use records

brief.zh: 学习目标：从数据使用记录判断泛化证据范围。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Judge generalization evidence from data-use records. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 模型准备服务新仓库。请审查三份评估记录能支持的范围：甲使用新仓库6月记录，答案已参与本次参数调整；乙用参数冻结后才取得的新仓库7月记录，对照真实结果评估，未用于调整；丙使用未参与调整的旧仓库保留记录，但没有新仓库资料。把记录送到符合证据范围的结论区。
prompt.en: A model will serve a new warehouse. Audit three evaluation records: A uses new-warehouse June records whose answers participated in parameter fitting; B evaluates against true outcomes on new-warehouse July records collected after parameters were frozen and never used for fitting; C evaluates held-out old-warehouse records never used for fitting, with no new-warehouse data. Route each record to its supported scope.

reason.zh: 甲虽然来自新仓库却已泄漏到学习，不能作本次独立证据；丙独立但只测旧条件；乙同时满足独立与当前用途相关。乙仍只支持已测条件，不保证所有未来场景。回看“历史数据与泛化、训练集与验证”。
reason.en: A comes from the new warehouse but has entered learning, so it is not independent. C is independent but tests only old conditions. B is both independent and relevant to the current use, while still supporting only tested conditions rather than every future situation. Revisit Generalization and Evaluation Sets.

text.zh: 提供新仓库条件下的独立检验证据
text.en: Independent evaluation evidence under new-warehouse conditions

text.zh: 只提供旧仓库条件下的独立证据
text.en: Independent evidence limited to old-warehouse conditions

text.zh: 不能当作本次独立检验
text.en: Not independent evaluation of this fitting run

text.zh: 甲：新仓库记录答案已参与参数调整
text.en: A: new-warehouse answers participated in parameter fitting

text.zh: 乙：冻结参数后取得、未用于学习的新仓库记录
text.en: B: new-warehouse records obtained after freezing and not used for learning

text.zh: 丙：未用于学习、但只来自旧仓库的记录
text.en: C: never used for learning, but only from the old warehouse

questions.q: 本演练：验证样本虽然独立，却完全来自旧业务环境。新环境可靠性的结论应如何表述？
questions.a: 仍需检验新环境差异，不能直接保证可靠
wrong: 只要独立就保证未来所有环境
历史数据永远无法用于任何模型

en.q: In this exercise: Evaluation examples are independent but entirely from the old business environment. How should new-environment reliability be stated?
en.a: New-environment differences still need assessment; reliability is not guaranteed
wrong: Independence guarantees every future environment
Historical data can never be useful

questions.quote: degradation of machine learning model performance due to changes in data or in the relationships between input and output variables.

rationale.zh: 原分类要求用途判断，保留
rationale.en: Retain purpose-based classification

misconception.zh: 高分不看数据来源
misconception.en: Scores matter regardless of provenance

title.zh: 保留未参与学习的检验资料
title.en: Preserve data not used in learning

brief.zh: 学习目标：保留未参与学习的检验资料。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Preserve data not used in learning. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练训练仍在进行。把已用于调参的样本与从未进入调参的保留测试样本分开，判断哪些能提供未见样本证据。
prompt.en: Training is still underway in this exercise. Separate examples already used for fitting from reserved tests never used for fitting, to identify unseen-case evidence.

text.zh: 已参与调参，不能作独立证据
text.en: Used for fitting; not independent evidence

text.zh: 未进入调参，可作独立测试候选
text.en: Not used for fitting; candidate independent test

text.zh: 训练样本及其答案
text.en: Training examples and answers

text.zh: 被同事加进训练的原测试答案
text.en: Former test answers a colleague added to training

text.zh: 未提供给训练的保留测试样本
text.en: Reserved tests never supplied to training

reason.zh: 标签“测试”不能洗掉实际泄漏；进入训练的答案不能再证明未见表现。保留数据仍要检查代表性与用途。 回看“验证证据隔离台”关联知识。
reason.en: Calling data test does not undo leakage. Answers used in training cannot establish unseen-case performance. Reserved data still needs fitness and representativeness checks. Revisit the knowledge linked to Evaluation-evidence separation desk.

questions.q: 本演练：开发者看过测试答案并据此改模型，测试分数上升。哪项下一步能重新提供独立证据？
questions.a: 使用未参与模型调整的新独立测试数据
wrong: 继续在同一测试答案上反复优化
删除低分记录保留高分

en.q: In this exercise: Developers inspect test answers and change the model, raising its score. What can restore independent evidence?
en.a: Use fresh independent test data not used in model adjustment
wrong: Keep optimizing on the same test answers
Delete low scores and keep high ones

questions.quote: models should not be evaluated on the same data they're trained on.

rationale.zh: 删除train/infer抄码，改证据归类
rationale.en: Remove train/infer transcription; classify evidence

misconception.zh: 术语统一即性能提高
misconception.en: Shared terms prove improved performance

title.zh: 以实际工作统一术语

brief.zh: 学习目标：以实际工作统一术语。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Align terms with actual work. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 业务和技术对“模型更新”理解不同：记录甲是系统加载同一版本参数处理新投诉；乙是用纠错样本改变权重并生成新参数版本；丙只是员工修改帮助文档。请把三项工作放到准确的讨论主题下。
prompt.en: Business and engineering disagree on model update. Record A loads the same parameter version for a new complaint; B changes weights from corrected examples and saves a new parameter version; C only edits a help document. Place them under accurate discussion topics.

reason.zh: 统一词汇应让团队说清实际发生的工作，而非背内部日志代码。外部文档变化既不自动训练模型，也不证明推理表现提高。回看“AI框架与统一词汇”。
reason.en: Shared vocabulary should describe what actually happened, not require memorized log codes. A document update neither automatically trains a model nor proves improved inference. Revisit Shared AI vocabulary.

text.zh: 运行模型处理输入
text.en: Run a model on input

text.zh: 学习调整模型参数
text.en: Learn and adjust model parameters

text.zh: 维护外部资料
text.en: Maintain external material

text.zh: 甲：同一参数版本处理新投诉
text.en: A: same parameter version handles a new complaint

text.zh: 乙：纠错样本驱动权重改变
text.en: B: corrected examples drive weight changes

text.zh: 丙：只修订帮助文档正文
text.en: C: only help-document text changes

questions.q: 本演练：技术与业务把“模型上线”和“训练完成”当作同一里程碑。会议先应达成什么？
questions.a: 共同定义术语及各阶段含义，再讨论方案
wrong: 用框架名称替代阶段定义
因使用框架而免除准确性检验

en.q: In this exercise: Business and engineering treat model deployment and training completion as one milestone. What should be agreed first?
en.a: Agree definitions and stage meanings before discussing the solution
wrong: Replace stage definitions with a framework name
Exempt accuracy tests because a framework is used

questions.quote: provides a conceptual framework and shared terminology for describing artificial intelligence (AI) systems that use machine learning (ML).

rationale.zh: 范围任务可保留，但正式标准要求仍需查原文
rationale.en: Retain scope awareness, not a formal compliance determination

misconception.zh: 读过标准名等于合规性能
misconception.en: Knowing a standard name proves compliance or performance

title.zh: 分清系统框架与管理体系的范围
title.en: Distinguish system framework and management scope

brief.zh: 学习目标：分清系统框架与管理体系的范围。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Distinguish system framework and management scope. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练只做参考资料索引：把问题送到对应范围，不能据索引宣称已经合规或保证准确。
prompt.en: This exercise only indexes references: route each question to its scope without claiming compliance or accuracy from the index.

text.zh: ISO/IEC 23053所涉系统框架
text.en: System framework scope of ISO/IEC 23053

text.zh: ISO/IEC 42001所涉组织管理体系
text.en: Organizational management-system scope of ISO/IEC 42001

text.zh: 想了解使用ML的AI系统框架
text.en: Seeking a framework for AI systems using ML

text.zh: 想了解组织AI管理体系
text.en: Seeking an organizational AI management system

reason.zh: 两个范围不能互相替代；此处仅为课程级意识，具体要求须查正式标准，不把名称当准确率保证。 回看“框架资料索引台”关联知识。
reason.en: The scopes are not interchangeable. This is course-level awareness; consult formal standards for actual requirements and do not use names as accuracy guarantees. Revisit the knowledge linked to Framework source index desk.

questions.q: 本演练：负责人要求从课程概览推导42001的全部实施条款。哪项回应符合材料边界？
questions.a: 概览只说明管理体系关注点，具体条款查正式标准
wrong: 可按编号自行编写全部条款
42001只讨论神经网络层数

en.q: In this exercise: An owner asks for every 42001 implementation clause from the course overview. Which response respects the material limits?
en.a: The overview gives management-system scope; consult the official standard for clauses
wrong: Invent all clauses from the number
42001 only concerns neural-network layer counts

questions.quote: provides a conceptual framework and shared terminology for describing artificial intelligence (AI) systems that use machine learning (ML).

rationale.zh: 原选型判断有成本边界，保留
rationale.en: Retain task and cost-based selection

misconception.zh: 规则必不属于AI
misconception.en: Rules cannot belong to AI

title.zh: 按任务与价值选择规则或学习型方法
title.en: Choose rules or learning by task and value

brief.zh: 学习目标：按任务与价值选择规则或学习型方法。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Choose rules or learning by task and value. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练：审批条件明确稳定，异常识别模式复杂难穷举。哪份建议更合理？
prompt.en: In this exercise: Approval conditions are stable, while anomaly patterns are complex. Which recommendation fits?

reason.zh: 规则系统也可能属于AI。这里比较确定性规则与学习型方法；按条件可表达性、价值、错误后果和维护成本选型。 常见误判：两个场景都必须上最复杂代理 回看相关知识与题面条件。
reason.en: Rule-based systems can also be AI. This comparison concerns deterministic rules and learning-based methods; choose according to how readily conditions can be expressed, value, error consequences and maintenance costs. Common error: Both require the most complex agent Revisit the linked knowledge and stated case conditions.

text.zh: 选AI时无需考虑维护成本
text.en: AI selection needs no maintenance assessment

text.zh: 审批先考虑确定性规则；异常识别评估学习型AI，并比较价值、错误后果与维护成本。
text.en: Consider deterministic rules for approval; evaluate learning-based AI for anomaly detection, comparing value, error consequences and maintenance costs.

text.zh: 两个场景都必须上最复杂代理
text.en: Both require the most complex agent

questions.q: 本演练：供应商建议把固定必填检查换成学习型AI，但未展示新增价值。评审应优先问什么？
questions.a: 相较确定性规则，价值、错误后果与维护成本如何
wrong: 模型名字是否最新
是否能把规则系统直接称为智能体

en.q: In this exercise: A vendor proposes learning-based AI for fixed mandatory-field checks without showing added value. What should reviewers ask first?
en.a: How value, error consequences and maintenance compare with deterministic rules
wrong: Whether the model name is newest
Whether rules can simply be renamed an agent

questions.quote: all machine learning is AI, but not all AI is machine learning.

rationale.zh: 现情境判定真实行动边界，保留
rationale.en: Retain concrete action boundaries

misconception.zh: 代理自主即无限权限
misconception.en: Autonomy means unlimited permissions

title.zh: 设计有界代理行动

brief.zh: 学习目标：设计有界代理行动。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Design bounded agent actions. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练：代理可查订单并拟定退款建议，团队准备开放真实退款工具。下一步应先补什么设计？
prompt.en: In this exercise: An agent can look up orders and draft refund advice. The team wants live refund access. What design is needed first?

reason.zh: 目标协调与外部行动权限不同，工具能力不能自动等于授权。 回看“AI代理与工具”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Goal coordination differs from external action authority; capability does not imply permission. Revisit AI agents and tools and check the evidence.

text.zh: 给代理目标后无需监督设计
text.en: A goal removes the need for oversight design

text.zh: 只要能聊天就默认可退款
text.en: Chat ability implies refund authority

text.zh: 明确行动权限、失败处理和人工监督
text.en: Define action permissions, failure handling and human oversight

questions.q: 本演练：两款助手都能生成回复，其中一款还会选择工具和协调步骤。新增能力主要带来哪项设计需求？
questions.a: 单独设计行动授权、失败处理与监督
wrong: 生成质量合格便证明所有行动安全
有目标就能跳过权限定义

en.q: In this exercise: Both assistants write replies; one also chooses tools and coordinates steps. What additional design need follows?
en.a: Design action authorization, failure handling and oversight separately
wrong: Good text proves all actions are safe
Having a goal permits skipping permissions

questions.quote: Although AI agents are autonomous in their decision-making processes, they require goals and predefined rules defined by humans.

rationale.zh: 原职责分流可保留
rationale.en: Retain responsibility routing

misconception.zh: 代理越多越好
misconception.en: More agents are always better

title.zh: 依据依赖分工与交接
title.en: Assign work and handoffs by dependencies

brief.zh: 学习目标：依据依赖分工与交接。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Assign work and handoffs by dependencies. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练报告必须引用检索证据；已定稿报告的两种独立版式互不读取对方产物。把动作分为需等待交接或可独立开展。这里只按题面依赖判断。
prompt.en: Exercise reports must cite retrieval evidence. Two layout variants of an already finalized report do not consume one another’s output. Classify actions as waiting for handoff or independently executable, using only these dependencies.

text.zh: 需等待前置交接
text.en: Must await a prerequisite handoff

text.zh: 此题可独立开展
text.en: Independent in this case

text.zh: 证据尚未交付就准备写依证报告
text.en: Writing an evidence-grounded report before evidence arrives

text.zh: 已获定稿后制作版式A
text.en: Prepare layout A after receiving the finalized report

text.zh: 已获定稿后制作版式B
text.en: Prepare layout B after receiving the finalized report

reason.zh: 是否依赖对方产物决定本题等待关系；角色多不代表交接质量高，需要检查来源、状态与任务完成。 回看“代理工作依赖分流”关联知识。
reason.en: Consuming another output determines the waiting relationship here. More roles do not establish handoff quality; check sources, status and task completion. Revisit the knowledge linked to Agent-work dependency routing.

questions.q: 本演练：新增审核代理后，报告反而丢失原文依据。最直接应检查哪个环节？
questions.a: 代理间交换信息和交接质量
wrong: 继续增加代理直到问题消失
只比较代理名称是否足够专业

en.q: In this exercise: Adding a review agent causes reports to lose source evidence. Which part should be checked most directly?
en.a: Information exchange and handoff quality
wrong: Keep adding agents until it disappears
Only compare how professional agent names sound

questions.quote: the process of coordinating multiple specialized AI agents within a unified system to efficiently achieve shared objectives.

rationale.zh: 保留数值观察；不把它当完整诊断证明
rationale.en: Retain numerical observation with diagnostic limits

misconception.zh: 变化即证明必须重训
misconception.en: Any change proves retraining is required

title.zh: 发现表现变化需调查原因
title.en: Detect performance change and investigate causes

brief.zh: 学习目标：发现表现变化需调查原因。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Detect performance change and investigate causes. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练同一口径下，基线100笔中错10笔，本次100笔中错18笔。填错误笔数增加多少、错误率增加多少个百分点；这里只做变化测量，不据此断言漂移根因。
prompt.en: Exercise under the same metric: baseline 10 errors in 100 cases, current 18 in 100. Enter additional errors and the increase in percentage points. Measure change only; this does not establish a drift cause.

reason.zh: 18−10=8笔，18%−10%=8个百分点；变化需结合输入、业务关系和反馈调查，不能由差值直接宣布根因或指定重训。 回看“部署变化测量台”关联知识。
reason.en: 18−10=8 errors and 18%−10%=8 percentage points. Investigate inputs, relationships and feedback; the difference alone does not establish a cause or mandate retraining. Revisit the knowledge linked to Deployment-change measurement desk.

questions.q: 本演练：上线首周验收正常，三个月后业务关系变化。原验收能否替代当前监测？
questions.a: 不能，应持续观察质量成本反馈并调查变化
wrong: 能，一次验收保证永久表现
只要模型文件没变就无需观察

en.q: In this exercise: Launch acceptance was good, but business relationships change three months later. Can it replace current monitoring?
en.a: No; keep observing quality, costs and feedback and investigate changes
wrong: Yes; one acceptance guarantees permanent performance
No observation is needed if the model file is unchanged

questions.quote: degradation of machine learning model performance due to changes in data or in the relationships between input and output variables.

rationale.zh: 原情境有实际用途边界，保留
rationale.en: Retain the specific use boundary

misconception.zh: 个人账号可绕过批准
misconception.en: Personal accounts bypass approval

title.zh: 按数据用途理解工具批准
title.en: Interpret tool approval by data use

brief.zh: 学习目标：按数据用途理解工具批准。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Interpret tool approval by data use. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练：员工因工作需求使用未批准工具，组织只有禁止名单。应补充什么？
prompt.en: In this exercise: Employees use unapproved tools to meet work needs and the organization only has a ban list. What is missing?

reason.zh: 可执行治理同时说明能用什么和怎么完成工作，不能只要求停用。 回看“工具分类与影子AI”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Actionable governance explains allowed tools and workable routes, rather than only demanding prohibition. Revisit Tool policies and shadow AI and check the evidence.

text.zh: 工具状态、数据边界和可用替代方案
text.en: Tool status, data boundaries and usable alternatives

text.zh: 公开可用就默认组织批准
text.en: Public availability implies organizational approval

text.zh: 只把禁止名单加长
text.en: Only lengthen the ban list

questions.q: 本演练：团队公开工具名单，却没说各工具可处理什么数据。治理验收还缺什么？
questions.a: 状态对应的数据使用边界和合适替代路线
wrong: 工具图标颜色
默认所有工具都可处理敏感资料

en.q: In this exercise: The team publishes a tool list without allowed data uses. What is missing from governance acceptance?
en.a: Data-use boundaries for each status and suitable alternatives
wrong: Tool icon colors
Assume every tool may process sensitive data

questions.quote: without the formal approval or oversight of the information technology (IT) department.

rationale.zh: 删除pass/review文字输入，改边界计数
rationale.en: Replace pass/review entry with boundary counting

misconception.zh: 等于阈值也算超过
misconception.en: Equality exceeds a strict threshold

title.zh: 同版规则可重复执行

brief.zh: 学习目标：同版规则可重复执行。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Execute a fixed-version rule reproducibly. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练同一版规则：金额严格大于100需复核，否则直接处理。本批金额是80、100、101、120、50。填写需复核与可直接处理的笔数；没有模型学习或规则版本变更。
prompt.en: Exercise rule version: amounts strictly greater than 100 require review; other cases proceed directly. Batch amounts are 80, 100, 101, 120 and 50. Enter the counts for review and direct handling; no learning or rule-version change occurs.

reason.zh: 101和120严格大于100；等于100仍走直接处理，所以2与3。判断依据是输入及同版明确条件，不是输入pass/review字符串。回看“确定性与可重复执行”。
reason.en: 101 and 120 are strictly above 100; equality goes to direct handling, producing counts 2 and 3. This applies an explicit rule rather than copies status codes. Revisit Deterministic execution.

questions.q: 本演练：相同申请在相同规则版本下两次得出不同结果，且输入完全一致。该现象最直接违反什么？
questions.a: 同输入同版本应得到同结果的可重复性
wrong: 必须使用生成模型的要求
规则系统不能使用阈值的要求

en.q: In this exercise: Identical applications and rule version produce different results with identical inputs. What is directly violated?
en.a: Repeatability: same input and rule version should yield the same result
wrong: A requirement to use a generative model
A rule that deterministic systems cannot use thresholds

questions.quote: A clearly specified mathematical process for computation; a set of rules that, if followed, will give a prescribed result.

rationale.zh: 原分流依据产物职责，保留
rationale.en: Retain artifact-based routing

misconception.zh: 同系统只能一种能力
misconception.en: A system can contain only one capability

title.zh: 区分预测、内容和行动验收
title.en: Distinguish prediction, content and action evaluation

brief.zh: 学习目标：区分预测、内容和行动验收。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Distinguish prediction, content and action evaluation. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练：把每项观察或任务放入对应类别。
prompt.en: In this exercise: put each observation or task in its matching category.

reason.zh: 输出估计、生成内容、外部行动各有不同失败方式，需分别验收。 回看“预测、生成与行动的边界”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Estimates, generated content and external actions have different failure modes and need separate acceptance. Revisit Prediction, generation and action and check the evidence.

text.zh: 预测
text.en: Prediction

text.zh: 生成
text.en: Generation

text.zh: 行动
text.en: Action

text.zh: 估计下周销量
text.en: Estimate next-week sales

text.zh: 起草采购说明
text.en: Draft procurement text

text.zh: 调用下单工具
text.en: Call the ordering tool

questions.q: 本演练：某系统预测正确、文字也合格，却未经授权执行采购。能整体通过验收吗？
questions.a: 不能，行动权限必须独立验收
wrong: 能，前两项可抵消越权
能，预测与行动是同一个验收维度

en.q: In this exercise: A system forecasts correctly and writes well but purchases without authority. Can overall acceptance pass?
en.a: No; action authority must pass independently
wrong: Yes; the first two offset unauthorized action
Yes; forecasting and action share one criterion

questions.quote: AI inference is the act of using a trained AI model to make predictions on new data.

rationale.zh: 旧题与示范同为授权失败；改双日志对照判断
rationale.en: Replace repeated denial with contrastive operational logs

misconception.zh: 所有失败都应重试或一律停止
misconception.en: All failures should retry or all must stop

title.zh: 按实际失败类型决定重试或停止
title.en: Decide retry versus stopping from failure evidence

brief.zh: 学习目标：按实际失败类型决定重试或停止。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Decide retry versus stopping from failure evidence. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练代理可在不扩大权限、且没有执行副作用的前提下，对临时连接故障最多重试2次；遇到权限边界须停止交负责人。日志甲：业务工具尚未收到请求，连接超时，已重试0次。日志乙：业务工具回复“当前角色无权执行此操作”，已重试0次。分别选择此刻允许的行动。
prompt.en: Exercise policy permits up to two retries for temporary connection failures only without broader authority or executed side effects; permission boundaries require stopping and handing over to the owner. Log A: the tool has not received the request, connection timed out, zero retries used. Log B: the tool replies that the current role cannot perform the operation, zero retries used. Select the permitted action for each log.

reason.zh: 甲符合本题限定的临时失败条件，可在额度内重试；乙缺授权，不能因次数还剩而继续或自行扩权。相同剩余次数不代表相同处置，需看失败类型与副作用。回看“自主性与停止条件”。
reason.en: A meets the stated temporary-failure conditions and may retry within the allowance. B lacks authority; remaining retries do not authorize continuing or expanding permissions. Equal remaining counts do not imply equal actions; inspect failure type and side effects. Revisit Autonomy and stop conditions.

text.zh: 日志甲：请求未到工具，连接超时
text.en: Log A: request did not reach the tool; connection timeout

text.zh: 日志乙：当前角色不能执行
text.en: Log B: current role is not authorized

text.zh: 只在既定额度和权限内重试
text.en: Retry only within existing allowance and authority

text.zh: 停止并交指定负责人处置
text.en: Stop and hand over to the designated owner

questions.q: 本演练：代理完成目标后仍继续调用工具，设计文档没有完成后停止规则。应补什么？
questions.a: 明确目标达成停止条件及异常升级
wrong: 取消所有次数限制让它自行决定
用更多目标文字替代执行边界

en.q: In this exercise: An agent keeps calling tools after meeting its goal; no completion stop rule exists. What should be added?
en.a: Explicit goal-completion stop conditions and exception escalation
wrong: Remove all call limits
Replace execution boundaries with more goal prose

questions.quote: Although AI agents are autonomous in their decision-making processes, they require goals and predefined rules defined by humans.

rationale.zh: 原题诊断实际契约缺口，保留
rationale.en: Retain contract-gap diagnosis

misconception.zh: 提示谨慎就等于授权
misconception.en: Caution in a prompt enforces authorization

title.zh: 工具契约要约束副作用
title.en: Constrain tool side effects with contracts

brief.zh: 学习目标：工具契约要约束副作用。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Constrain tool side effects with contracts. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练：退款工具只有输入输出说明，尚无授权和错误定义。上线评审应要求什么？
prompt.en: In this exercise: A refund tool specifies inputs and outputs but lacks authorization and error definitions. What must the launch review require?

reason.zh: 外部状态改变必须靠工具契约与服务端授权，文字提醒不能替代执行边界。 回看“工具契约与最小行动权限”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: State-changing calls need tool contracts and server-side authorization; prose reminders do not enforce boundaries. Revisit Tool contracts and action permissions and check the evidence.

text.zh: 补齐错误、授权、副作用及服务端权限检查和审计
text.en: Add errors, authorization, side effects, server-side permission checks and auditing

text.zh: 只在提示里写请谨慎退款
text.en: Only tell the model to refund carefully

text.zh: 可调用就证明所有用户都获授权
text.en: Callability proves all users are authorized

questions.q: 本演练：网页按钮隐藏了退款入口，但服务端仍接受无权限调用。哪项修复触及根因？
questions.a: 服务端校验授权并记录审计，完善错误契约
wrong: 只把按钮再藏深一些
只在模型提示加入不要越权

en.q: In this exercise: The UI hides refunds but the server accepts unauthorized calls. Which fix addresses the cause?
en.a: Enforce server authorization and auditing and complete the error contract
wrong: Only hide the button more deeply
Only add do not exceed authority to the prompt

questions.quote: define the APIs that can be called, how to handle the action, and how to return the response.

rationale.zh: 原题先给步骤后照排；改依赖调度分类
rationale.en: Replace supplied sequence with dependency scheduling

misconception.zh: 独立任务不需交接状态
misconception.en: Independent work needs no state handoff

title.zh: 按证据依赖安排交接

brief.zh: 学习目标：按证据依赖安排交接。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Schedule handoff by evidence dependency. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 一份带引用报告要引用本次检索找到的材料。当前检索员尚未产出材料，时间已经很紧。把候选安排分到“可先做”或“必须等证据与交接”。不要把赶进度当作消除依赖。
prompt.en: A referenced report must cite material found by this retrieval run. The retriever has not produced it and time is short. Route candidate arrangements to work that can start or work that must await evidence and handover. Time pressure does not remove dependencies.

reason.zh: 格式准备与检索可先开展；具体结论要用实际证据，交接还需来源、状态和人类处置负责人。能识别可并行与受阻工作，而非照给定步骤排序。回看“交接与编排”。
reason.en: Formatting and retrieval can begin; evidence-specific conclusions need actual material. Handover must retain sources, status and a human response owner. Revisit Handoffs and orchestration.

text.zh: 可先做的准备工作
text.en: Preparatory work that can start

text.zh: 必须等证据与交接
text.en: Must await evidence and handover

text.zh: 确定报告格式和交付目标
text.en: Clarify report format and delivery goal

text.zh: 检索员查找获授权资料并记录来源
text.en: Retriever searches authorized sources and records provenance

text.zh: 撰写员据本次资料写具体结论与引用
text.en: Writer states source-specific conclusions and citations

questions.q: 本演练：两名代理分别抽查互不依赖的两份资料，汇总者需保留来源与失败状态。哪项编排合理？
questions.a: 受控并行独立检查，再按明确交接汇总
wrong: 汇总前删除来源以节省交接
任务独立就无需保留失败状态或指定人类处置负责人

en.q: In this exercise: Two agents inspect independent documents; the aggregator needs sources and failure states. Which orchestration is reasonable?
en.a: Run independent checks in controlled parallel, then aggregate through explicit handoffs
wrong: Delete sources before aggregation to save handoff effort
Independent tasks need no failure-state records or designated human response owner

questions.quote: the process of coordinating multiple specialized AI agents within a unified system to efficiently achieve shared objectives.

rationale.zh: 已限定模型输入并保留业务影响调查，保留
rationale.en: Retain specified inputs and impact investigation

misconception.zh: 分布变化必然伤害业务
misconception.en: Distribution change guarantees business harm

title.zh: 区分输入漂移与关系变化证据

brief.zh: 学习目标：区分输入漂移与关系变化证据。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Distinguish input and relationship change. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练：把每项观察或任务放入对应类别。
prompt.en: In this exercise: put each observation or task in its matching category.

reason.zh: 输入变化不是业务损害的充分证据，区分观察和推断避免错误发布。 回看“数据漂移与概念漂移”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Input change alone does not establish business harm; separate observation from inference. Revisit Data drift and concept drift and check the evidence.

text.zh: 输入分布变化
text.en: Input distribution change

text.zh: 输入与目标关系变化
text.en: Input-target relationship change

text.zh: 新客户用词变化
text.en: New customers use different language

text.zh: 本演练模型仅以价格为输入；调查已确认促销期间同一价格对应的需求分布改变
text.en: The exercise model uses only price as input; investigation confirms demand distributions at the same price changed during promotion

questions.q: 本演练：本演练模型仅输入价格，调查已确认同价格下需求分布变化；即使价格分布没变，应重点调查什么？
questions.a: 输入与目标关系的概念漂移及其业务影响
wrong: 仅凭此就认定价格输入分布漂移
价格分布未变就证明模型不会受影响

en.q: In this exercise: The exercise model only inputs price; investigation confirms changed demand distributions at fixed prices. Prices themselves have not shifted. What deserves investigation?
en.a: Concept drift in input-target relationships and business impact
wrong: Conclude from this alone that input price distributions shifted
Unchanged price distributions prove no model impact

questions.quote: degradation of machine learning model performance due to changes in data or in the relationships between input and output variables.

rationale.zh: 独立题曾复用正式紧急回退情境；改未触发预案的常规修复决策
rationale.en: Separate application from the urgent formal item using routine remediation

misconception.zh: 告警决定唯一原因或开发样本证明可发布
misconception.en: An alert proves one cause or development scores prove release readiness

title.zh: 未触发紧急条件时先查因并独立验证修复
title.en: Investigate and independently validate when no urgent trigger is present

brief.zh: 学习目标：未触发紧急条件时先查因并独立验证修复。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Investigate and independently validate when no urgent trigger is present. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 一次例行监测发现质量较基线下降，但本演练没有触发组织的紧急回退条件。团队做了一项候选修复，只在用于开发它的样本上看过结果；有人准备立即把它用于全部请求。根因尚未确认。选择目前有证据支持的全部行动。
prompt.en: Routine monitoring finds quality below its baseline, but no organizational urgent-rollback condition is triggered in this exercise. A candidate fix has been examined only on the examples used to develop it; someone proposes applying it to all requests immediately. The cause is unconfirmed. Select every action currently supported.

reason.zh: 基线下降触发调查，不能直接证明原因或处置。开发样本不是独立修复证据，扩大部署要等验证；本情境未触发紧急回退，不能把不同响应条件一律套成同一种处置。回看“监测基线与反馈闭环”。
reason.en: A baseline decline calls for investigation, not a predetermined cause or remedy. Development examples are not independent evidence for a fix; expansion requires validation. No urgent trigger is present here; different response conditions cannot be treated as one rigid procedure. Revisit Monitoring baselines and feedback.

text.zh: 在未参与开发的代表性资料上验证修复，再决定是否扩大使用
text.en: Validate the fix on representative material not used in its development before deciding expansion

text.zh: 只因开发样本表现好就立即全量替换
text.en: Replace the system everywhere because development examples look good

text.zh: 只要出现告警就认定唯一解决办法是重训
text.en: Treat any alert as proof that retraining is the only solution

text.zh: 调查输入、业务关系和相关版本变化，核实下降原因
text.en: Investigate changes in inputs, business relationships and relevant versions to establish the cause

questions.q: 本演练：延迟已超过组织预设的紧急回退阈值，已验证的回退方案可用，但根因与修复尚未确认。应如何处理？
questions.a: 按预案先回退，再调查原因并验证修复；修复验证后再扩大部署。
wrong: 必须等待修复验证完成才允许回退
把尚未验证的修复直接扩大部署

en.q: In this exercise, latency exceeds the predefined urgent rollback threshold and a tested rollback plan is available, but the cause and fix are unconfirmed. What should happen?
en.a: Follow the rollback plan first, then investigate the cause and validate the fix before expanding deployment again.
wrong: Wait for completed fix validation before permitting rollback
Expand deployment of an unvalidated fix

questions.quote: degradation of machine learning model performance due to changes in data or in the relationships between input and output variables.

rationale.zh: 具体数据用途判定仍有效，保留
rationale.en: Retain data-purpose judgment

misconception.zh: 已批准工具可接一切资料
misconception.en: Approved tools may accept all data

title.zh: 用批准范围和需求反馈治理影子AI
title.en: Govern shadow AI through approved scope and feedback

brief.zh: 学习目标：用批准范围和需求反馈治理影子AI。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Govern shadow AI through approved scope and feedback. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练：本演练工具X仅批准处理公开资料，员工要处理敏感合同。应怎么做？
prompt.en: In this exercise: Exercise tool X is approved only for public data, but an employee needs to process a sensitive contract. What should happen?

reason.zh: 批准状态必须结合具体数据和用途，替代渠道才能让治理可执行。 回看“工具分级与影子AI”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Approval must be combined with data and purpose limits; alternatives make governance actionable. Revisit Tool classification and shadow AI and check the evidence.

text.zh: 使用获准处理敏感资料的渠道，缺渠道则反馈需求
text.en: Use an approved sensitive-data route or report the unmet need

text.zh: 换个人账号就是合规替代
text.en: A personal account is a compliant alternative

text.zh: 工具已批准就可以处理任何资料
text.en: Approval allows any data

questions.q: 本演练：员工报告批准工具无法完成必要工作，已有禁令但替代路线不存在。最符合治理目标的措施是什么？
questions.a: 提供可用替代、培训和需求反馈渠道
wrong: 只重复禁令而不处理需求
把未经管理的使用自动改称批准

en.q: In this exercise: Employees report approved tools cannot meet a needed task; bans exist but no alternative route does. Which action fits governance goals?
en.a: Provide workable alternatives, training and a needs-feedback channel
wrong: Only repeat the ban without addressing needs
Automatically relabel unmanaged use as approved

questions.quote: without the formal approval or oversight of the information technology (IT) department.

rationale.zh: 原题要求完整任务书，保留
rationale.en: Retain the complete-brief decision

misconception.zh: 只修辞不测任务
misconception.en: Rhetoric replaces task tests

title.zh: 提示明确任务并代表性测试
title.en: Specify prompt tasks and representative tests

brief.zh: 学习目标：提示明确任务并代表性测试。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Specify prompt tasks and representative tests. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练：团队只有一条“帮我总结”提示和一个漂亮回答。应补哪项设计？
prompt.en: In this exercise: The team has only a summarize prompt and one impressive answer. What design should be added?

reason.zh: 提示质量来自任务明确与代表性验证，不是修辞或单次观感。 回看“提示工程”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Prompt quality comes from clear tasks and representative evaluation, not rhetoric or a single impression. Revisit Prompt engineering and check the evidence.

text.zh: 明确目标、背景、约束、输出，并用代表任务验证
text.en: Specify goal, context, constraints and output, then evaluate representative tasks

text.zh: 一条好回答证明所有场景可用
text.en: One good answer proves all scenarios work

text.zh: 只加入更多赞美模型的文字
text.en: Only add praise for the model

questions.q: 本演练：提示改为很长以后，只在一个示例上改善。该证据能否证明可复用？
questions.a: 不能，应检查目标约束输出并测试代表任务
wrong: 能，长度直接证明提示质量
能，所有其他任务都可由一例推断

en.q: In this exercise: A much longer prompt improves one example. Does this prove reusability?
en.a: No; check goals, constraints and output and test representative tasks
wrong: Yes; length proves quality
Yes; one example establishes all other tasks

questions.quote: few-shot prompting, which provides the model with sample outputs to clarify expectations.

rationale.zh: 有新数值需实际计算，保留
rationale.en: Retain actual numeric computation

misconception.zh: 字数等于词元数
misconception.en: Characters always equal tokens

title.zh: 核算输入输出共同窗口

brief.zh: 学习目标：核算输入输出共同窗口。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Budget shared input/output context. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练：窗口1000；输入800、输出预留300。填写至少需要减少的词元数，所有数字均为演练假设。
prompt.en: In this exercise: Window 1,000; input 800 and reserved output 300. Enter the minimum token reduction; all numbers are exercise assumptions.

reason.zh: 输入和输出共享窗口，预算超出不能只看输入；词元数须按实际分词。 回看“词元与上下文窗口”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Input and output share the window; checking input alone misses overflow, and tokens require actual tokenization. Revisit Tokens and context windows and check the evidence.

questions.q: 本演练：用户说文件都上传了就一定能在一次请求中被有效利用。应澄清什么？
questions.a: 请求上下文有限，需规划预算并筛选相关片段
wrong: 上传数量不受任何上下文限制
窗口越大就不需要验证答案

en.q: In this exercise: A user assumes every uploaded file is effectively used in one request. What needs clarification?
en.a: Request context is limited; budget and select relevant passages
wrong: Uploads face no context limits
Larger windows remove answer verification

questions.quote: all the text a language model can reference when generating a response, including the response itself.

rationale.zh: 用未给完整顺序的真实资料流程替换旧排序
rationale.en: Replace the old sequence with artifact-based construction

misconception.zh: 检索成功即回答正确
misconception.en: Successful retrieval guarantees the answer

title.zh: 从资料到回答建立可核验依赖

brief.zh: 学习目标：从资料到回答建立可核验依赖。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Build evidence-to-answer dependencies. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 制度助手需要回答当前退货问题，资料权限已确认，但还没有拿到支持本问题的具体片段。用这些工作卡建立可检查的答复过程。不要把尚未取得的资料当成生成依据。
prompt.en: A policy assistant must answer a current returns question. Access is confirmed, but no passage supporting this question has been retrieved. Build an inspectable answer process from the work cards without treating unavailable material as context.

reason.zh: 上下文必须来自已找到的片段，候选答复出现后才可核对具体结论。这里通过信息输入输出依赖推导顺序，不给完整箭头答案；检索成功不保证生成正确。回看“RAG”。
reason.en: Context depends on retrieved passages, and checking a concrete claim depends on a candidate answer. These information dependencies determine order; retrieval success does not guarantee grounding. Revisit RAG.

text.zh: 逐项核对候选结论是否被片段支持
text.en: Check whether each candidate claim is supported by the passages

text.zh: 生成面向该问题的候选答复
text.en: Generate a candidate answer to the question

text.zh: 把找到的片段作为本次生成的上下文
text.en: Supply the retrieved passages as this generation context

text.zh: 找出当前且相关的获授权政策片段
text.en: Find current relevant authorized policy passages

questions.q: 本演练：RAG助手引用了过期政策，团队以“有检索”作为正确性证明。哪项诊断准确？
questions.a: 仍需核对版本、权限和回答依据，检索不保证正确
wrong: 有检索就自动通过所有验收
只修改回答语气即可修正政策版本

en.q: In this exercise: A RAG assistant cites an obsolete policy and the team cites retrieval as proof of correctness. What is the right diagnosis?
en.a: Version, permissions and answer support still need checks; retrieval does not guarantee correctness
wrong: Retrieval automatically passes all acceptance
Changing tone fixes the source version

questions.quote: references an authoritative knowledge base outside of its training data sources before generating a response.

rationale.zh: 原场景含动态更新约束，保留
rationale.en: Retain the changing-fact constraint

misconception.zh: 加入上下文就是微调
misconception.en: Adding context is fine-tuning

title.zh: 区分参数适配和事实维护
title.en: Distinguish parameter adaptation from source maintenance

brief.zh: 学习目标：区分参数适配和事实维护。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Distinguish parameter adaptation from source maintenance. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练：客服要统一风格，同时纳入今天变更政策。对微调能力应如何说明？
prompt.en: In this exercise: Support needs consistent style and today’s policy update. How should fine-tuning be described?

reason.zh: 参数调整与请求补充信息不同，风格与动态事实需求要分开处理。 回看“微调 Fine-tuning”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Parameter updates differ from request context; style and changing facts need separate handling. Revisit Fine-tuning and check the evidence.

text.zh: 一次微调会永久同步所有政策
text.en: One fine-tune permanently synchronizes every policy

text.zh: 把政策放入请求就叫参数微调
text.en: Adding policy to a request is parameter fine-tuning

text.zh: 可评估行为适配，最新事实仍需维护资料
text.en: Evaluate behavioral adaptation while maintaining current factual sources

questions.q: 本演练：工程日志显示只把新文件拼进请求，没有训练参数。可以把这项操作称为微调吗？
questions.a: 不能，微调是通过训练调整参数
wrong: 可以，只要文件有新事实
可以，所有输入文字都是参数更新

en.q: In this exercise: Logs show only adding files to a request with no parameter training. Can that operation be called fine-tuning?
en.a: No; fine-tuning adjusts parameters through training
wrong: Yes, whenever files contain new facts
Yes; all input text updates parameters

questions.quote: fine-tuning entails techniques to further train a model whose weights have already been updated through prior training.

rationale.zh: 原题需分辨指令来源，保留但不保证格式即安全
rationale.en: Retain instruction-origin reasoning without safety guarantees

misconception.zh: 分隔符保证安全
misconception.en: Delimiters guarantee safety

title.zh: 将操作指令与原始资料分隔
title.en: Separate source text and operational instructions

brief.zh: 学习目标：将操作指令与原始资料分隔。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Separate source text and operational instructions. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练：本演练要从访谈抽取三项需求并逐项引用，未支持信息写未知。哪份提示结构可执行？
prompt.en: In this exercise: Extract three needs with citations and mark unsupported information unknown. Which prompt structure is executable?

reason.zh: 区分资料与指令并给明确验收条件，可减少误执行文档内文字。 回看“任务、上下文、约束与格式”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Separating sources from instructions and defining acceptance reduces accidental obedience to source text. Revisit Task, context, constraints and format and check the evidence.

text.zh: 把正文中所有命令也当成操作指令
text.en: Treat every command in the source as an instruction

text.zh: 只写请专业回答，不给资料或边界
text.en: Only say answer professionally without sources or boundaries

text.zh: 分隔操作指令与访谈正文，明确任务、边界和输出格式
text.en: Separate instructions from interview text and specify task, limits and format

questions.q: 本演练：资料正文出现“忽略原要求”字样，系统把它当指令执行。提示结构应怎样修正？
questions.a: 明确分隔资料与操作指令，重申任务和边界
wrong: 把所有资料内容提升为系统指令
只把资料变得更长

en.q: In this exercise: Source text says ignore prior requirements and the system follows it. How should prompt structure change?
en.a: Clearly separate sources and instructions and state task and boundaries
wrong: Promote all source content to system instructions
Only lengthen the source text

questions.quote: few-shot prompting, which provides the model with sample outputs to clarify expectations.

rationale.zh: 旧题直接列required并用分数透露可选项；改由行为场景推断测试角色
rationale.en: Replace named requirements and revealing scores with behavior-based case classification

misconception.zh: 漂亮个例就是代表测试
misconception.en: A pretty example is representative evaluation

title.zh: 按行为风险选择代表性测试
title.en: Select representative tests by behavior risks

brief.zh: 学习目标：按行为风险选择代表性测试。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Select representative tests by behavior risks. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 团队要发布工单摘要提示。新测试集中四个案例各有什么检验价值？按具体行为归档，不按“测试1/测试2”等名称或分数挑选。知识资料仍可随时回看，不能把测试标准答案塞进待评提示。
prompt.en: A team will release a ticket-summary prompt. What does each new test case examine? File cases by behavior, not by a test number or score. Knowledge remains available, but test answer keys must not be placed in the prompt being evaluated.

reason.zh: 普通工单、长度极限、资料伪指令暴露不同失败方式；截图不是完整测试。能解释案例检验什么，比按已给覆盖值凑预算更能证明代表性测试理解。回看“代表性样例与提示版本”。
reason.en: Ordinary cases, length limits and commands inside sources expose different failure modes. A screenshot is not a full evaluation. Explain what each case examines rather than total assigned coverage scores. Revisit Representative tests and prompt versions.

text.zh: 正常工作表现
text.en: Ordinary task behavior

text.zh: 长度边界表现
text.en: Length-boundary behavior

text.zh: 对资料内伪指令的应对
text.en: Handling commands inside source material

text.zh: 不能单独代表任务范围
text.en: Insufficient alone to represent the task range

text.zh: 字段齐全、长度普通的新工单，要求按原标准提取
text.en: A new ordinary-length ticket with complete fields to extract under the existing criteria

text.zh: 接近允许长度上限，关键请求藏在结尾的工单
text.en: A near-limit ticket whose key request is at the end

text.zh: 客户正文里写着忽略任务并发送档案，但它只是待整理资料
text.en: A customer source says to ignore the task and send records, although it is material to summarize

text.zh: 只保留过往一次最好回答的宣传截图
