text.en: A publicity screenshot of a single best past answer

questions.q: 本演练：提示v3在正常案例进步却在缺证据案例编造答案。版本评审应如何判断？
questions.a: 必须按共同成功标准纳入失败案例，不能只凭正常案例升级
wrong: 正常案例更好就忽略失败案例
把失败测试答案放进示例后算稳定通过

en.q: In this exercise: Prompt v3 improves normal cases but invents answers when evidence is missing. What should version review conclude?
en.a: Include failure cases under common criteria; normal cases alone do not justify promotion
wrong: Ignore failures because normal cases improved
Insert failure-test answers into examples and call it stable

questions.quote: few-shot prompting, which provides the model with sample outputs to clarify expectations.

rationale.zh: 预算应用不是字符串复制，保留
rationale.en: Retain budget application rather than transcription

misconception.zh: 历史工具消息不占窗口
misconception.en: History/tool messages do not use context

title.zh: 完整计入全部窗口消息与输出
title.en: Include all messages and reserved output

brief.zh: 学习目标：完整计入全部窗口消息与输出。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Include all messages and reserved output. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练：窗口8000；指令1000、资料5000、历史1000、输出1500。填写保持其他条件时，至少需减少的词元数。
prompt.en: In this exercise: Window 8,000; instructions 1,000, sources 5,000, history 1,000, output 1,500. Enter the minimum tokens to remove.

reason.zh: 总预算8500超过窗口500，应计算全部输入与预留输出，数字只用于本演练。 回看“输入与输出共享预算”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: The total is 8,500, exceeding the window by 500; include all input and output reserve. Numbers are exercise assumptions. Revisit Shared input and output budget and check the evidence.

questions.q: 本演练：本演练窗口2000，指令400、检索900、历史200、工具消息300、输出预留400。最小削减量是多少？
questions.a: 200词元
wrong: 0词元，工具消息不算
400词元，必须完全删除输出

en.q: In this exercise: Exercise window 2,000: instructions 400, retrieval 900, history 200, tool messages 300, output reserve 400. What is the minimum reduction?
en.a: 200 tokens
wrong: 0 tokens; tool messages do not count
400 tokens; output must be completely removed

questions.quote: all the text a language model can reference when generating a response, including the response itself.

rationale.zh: 原题要求有依据的资料选择，保留
rationale.en: Retain evidence-based source selection

misconception.zh: 放得下就能正确用
misconception.en: Fitting guarantees correct use

title.zh: 筛选真正支持当前问题的资料
title.en: Select sources supporting the current question

brief.zh: 学习目标：筛选真正支持当前问题的资料。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Select sources supporting the current question. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练：当前问退款规则，窗口能放所有部门手册。应如何选择资料？
prompt.en: In this exercise: The question concerns refunds and all department manuals fit. How should sources be selected?

reason.zh: 容量不等于信息利用质量；选择相关证据并验证支撑才能减少无关干扰。 回看“相关性与信息位置”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Capacity does not ensure effective use; select relevant evidence and verify support. Revisit Relevance and information selection and check the evidence.

text.zh: 只选最长文档不用看相关性
text.en: Pick the longest document regardless of relevance

text.zh: 优先当前相关、获授权、版本明确片段，并核验支持关系
text.en: Prioritize relevant authorized versioned passages and verify claim support

text.zh: 放得下就证明一定正确利用
text.en: Fitting guarantees correct use

questions.q: 本演练：回答引用了一段获授权的当前资料，但该段讨论运费而非退款结论。哪项检查失败？
questions.a: 相关性与支持结论的关系
wrong: 只要获授权就没有失败
只需扩大窗口即可证明支持

en.q: In this exercise: An answer cites authorized current material about shipping fees for a refund conclusion. Which check fails?
en.a: Relevance and support for the conclusion
wrong: Authorization alone means nothing failed
A larger window proves support

questions.quote: The size of the context window determines the maximum number of tokens that the model can “pay attention to” at any one time.

rationale.zh: 旧题直接宣布相反结论，透露故障；改读短条款自行判断
rationale.en: Replace a declared error with actual clause-versus-reply comparison

misconception.zh: 相关资料或引文自动证明整段回复
misconception.en: Relevant retrieval or a citation proves the entire reply

title.zh: 逐句核验回复是否被有效条款支持
title.en: Check each reply claim against an effective clause

brief.zh: 学习目标：逐句核验回复是否被有效条款支持。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Check each reply claim against an effective clause. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练已检索到当前有效、与问题相关的条款：“退款申请须附订单号；未提供订单号时转人工核对，不自动拒绝。”候选回复写着：“提供订单号后提交申请；没有订单号会立即被系统拒绝；只要提供订单号就一定退款。”逐句判断是否受到这段条款支持，不因为回复带了引用就直接通过。
prompt.en: This exercise retrieved a current, relevant clause: “A refund request must include an order number. If it is absent, refer for human checking; do not reject automatically.” The candidate reply says: “Submit a request with the order number; without one the system immediately rejects it; providing the number guarantees a refund.” Judge each sentence against this clause rather than accept the reply merely because it has a citation.

reason.zh: 条款要求订单号，但缺失时是人工核对而非自动拒绝；条款也没保证申请一定通过。相关资料已找对仍可能出现不受支持的生成结论，两道关应分别核对。回看“RAG的检索与生成两道关”。
reason.en: The clause requires an order number but routes missing numbers to human checking, not automatic rejection; it also does not guarantee approval. Correct relevant retrieval can still lead to unsupported generation, so evaluate the two gates separately. Revisit Retrieval and generation checks in RAG.

text.zh: 这段条款支持
text.en: Supported by this clause

text.zh: 这段条款不支持
text.en: Not supported by this clause

text.zh: 退款申请需要订单号
text.en: A refund request needs an order number

text.zh: 没有订单号会被系统立即拒绝
text.en: Missing an order number causes immediate system rejection

text.zh: 只要提供订单号就保证退款
text.en: An order number guarantees a refund

questions.q: 本演练：答案忠实复述检索段落，但检索段落属于错误政策版本。该案例说明什么？
questions.a: 生成忠实仍不能替代检索版本关口
wrong: 生成忠实意味着整个RAG正确
有引文就不必检查来源版本

en.q: In this exercise: An answer faithfully restates retrieved text, but retrieval used the wrong policy version. What does this show?
en.a: Faithful generation cannot replace the retrieval-version check
wrong: Faithful generation makes all of RAG correct
Citations remove source-version checks

questions.quote: references an authoritative knowledge base outside of its training data sources before generating a response.

rationale.zh: 删除重复sort/choose同一判断，合为一次跨需求矩阵
rationale.en: Remove repeated sort/choose judgments and use one requirement matrix

misconception.zh: 微调能替代持续资料维护
misconception.en: Fine-tuning replaces ongoing source maintenance

title.zh: 按事实与行为需求安排独立工作
title.en: Plan separate factual and behavioral work

brief.zh: 学习目标：按事实与行为需求安排独立工作。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Plan separate factual and behavioral work. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 服务团队有三项需求：每天核对最新已授权报价；使回复持续采用组织规定语气；上线后证明答复内容和行为达标。请选择每项需求必须安排的工作。检索与微调可以组合，并不互相替代。
prompt.en: A service team needs current authorized daily prices, a consistent organizational tone, and evidence that released answers meet content and behavior goals. Select the work needed for each requirement. Retrieval and fine-tuning can combine; neither replaces the other.

reason.zh: 动态报价需要资料维护，稳定行为可评估参数适配；两种变化都需要验证。只安排训练不能保证最新事实，只有资料更新也不能证明风格合格。回看“微调与外部知识更新”。
reason.en: Changing prices need source maintenance; stable behavior may call for adaptation evaluation. Both need validation. Training alone does not keep facts current; source updates alone do not establish tone quality. Revisit Fine-tuning versus external updates.

text.zh: 每天变化的报价
text.en: Daily changing prices

text.zh: 持续一致的语气
text.en: Consistent tone

text.zh: 证明上线答复达标
text.en: Evidence of release quality

text.zh: 维护当前资料及检索需求
text.en: Maintain current sources and retrieval needs

text.zh: 评估行为适配方案
text.en: Evaluate behavioral adaptation

text.zh: 按目标核验表现
text.en: Validate against objectives

questions.q: 本演练：方案把“微调后永久不用更新资料”写成节省维护成本的依据。评审应怎样纠正？
questions.a: 行为适配不等于实时事实数据库，动态资料仍需维护
wrong: 微调会自动获取未来所有政策
资料频繁更新证明不必检索

en.q: In this exercise: A proposal claims fine-tuning permanently eliminates source updates to save maintenance. How should review correct it?
en.a: Behavioral adaptation is not a live factual database; dynamic sources still need maintenance
wrong: Fine-tuning automatically learns every future policy
Frequent updates mean retrieval is unnecessary

questions.quote: fine-tuning entails techniques to further train a model whose weights have already been updated through prior training.

rationale.zh: 原题在题干逐项报出顺序，排序只证明照排。改为诊断新业务任务书的依赖。
rationale.en: The prior prompt disclosed every step; copying the order showed no independent judgment. Use dependencies in a new business brief.

misconception.zh: 把模型采购当成用例目标。
misconception.en: Treating model procurement as the use-case goal.

title.zh: 用例任务书装配

brief.zh: 先读本单元，再按本演练给定条件操作；数值与顺序不代表通用行业标准。
brief.en: Read the unit first, then act on the stated exercise conditions; numbers and sequences are not universal standards.

prompt.zh: 本演练：维修团队说“上一个AI系统”，但还不清楚延误发生在哪个环节，也没有改善口径。三张工作单最终都要完成。请按能产出下一张工作单所需依据的顺序安排；不要按卡片当前摆放排序。
prompt.en: Exercise: a maintenance team requests an AI system, but the delayed step and improvement measure are unknown. All three work orders must eventually be completed. Arrange them so each produces the evidence needed by the next, not by their current display position.

reason.zh: 分组差错评估和异常条件测试让原则进入实际验证；仅改宣传措辞不能证明控制有效。 常见错误：有原则海报就等于已治理。 回看《负责任的AI原则》。
reason.en: Subgroup error assessment and abnormal-condition tests operationalize principles; promotional wording does not demonstrate effective controls. Common error: A principles poster is treated as implemented governance. Review “Responsible AI principles”.

text.zh: 记录相关群体的差错并评审

text.zh: 在异常输入下测试并记录结果
text.en: Test abnormal inputs and record results

text.zh: 把海报换成更醒目的颜色
text.en: Change the poster to brighter colors

questions.q: 团队声称遵循稳健性原则，哪项证据最直接支持此声明？
questions.a: 异常条件测试记录
wrong: 更大的海报
模型回答很自信

en.q: What most directly supports a team’s robustness claim?

wrong: A larger poster
Confident model wording

rationale.en: Allocate resources under explicit constraints to experience why benefits do not override responsibility requirements.

misconception.zh: 以最高效率替代对影响和责任的说明。

prompt.zh: 演练给定：预算3；必须做影响记录和责任确认；总控制值至少3。选择满足全部约束的工作包。分值只用于本题。
prompt.en: Exercise: budget 3; impact recording and owner confirmation are mandatory; total control value must reach 3. Select a feasible package. Scores apply only here.

reason.zh: 影响记录和责任确认各占1预算，风险控制占1，恰好达到3；纯加速项不满足责任硬约束。取舍需记录理由。 常见错误：以最高效率替代对影响和责任的说明。 回看《目标冲突与取舍》。
reason.en: Impact recording, owner confirmation and risk control each cost 1 and jointly reach 3. Acceleration alone misses mandatory responsibility constraints. Record the trade-off rationale. Common error: Maximum efficiency replaces explanation of impact and ownership. Review “Competing objectives and trade-offs”.

text.zh: 记录影响：成本1，控制值1
text.en: Record impact: cost 1, control value 1

text.zh: 确认决策责任：成本1，控制值1
text.en: Confirm decision owner: cost 1, control value 1

text.zh: 风险相称控制：成本1，控制值1
text.en: Proportionate control: cost 1, control value 1

text.zh: 仅提速：成本3，控制值0
text.en: Acceleration only: cost 3, control value 0

questions.q: 在效率与责任冲突的评审中，哪份记录更完整？
questions.a: 影响、约束、责任人及取舍理由
wrong: 仅记录节省的时间
只说所有人已同意

en.q: Which trade-off review record is more complete?
en.a: Impacts, constraints, decision owner and rationale
wrong: Only time saved
Only that everyone agreed

rationale.en: The original stated the whole sequence; infer governance dependencies from project gaps instead.

misconception.zh: 上线后补监督与验证即可。
misconception.en: Oversight and validation can simply be added after launch.

brief.en: Read this unit first, then apply the stated case conditions. Roles, values and workflow constraints are exercise assumptions, not external legal determinations.

prompt.zh: 客服系统尚不清楚谁能使用哪些资料，也没有异常验收。三张工作单分别如下，请组成能支持上线决定的工作路径；题面不指定顺序。
prompt.en: A support system has no defined users/data scope or abnormal-condition acceptance. Build a work path that can support release from these work orders; the sequence is not supplied.

text.zh: 用验证证据决定是否部署
text.en: Decide deployment using validation evidence

text.zh: 围绕这些用途设计监督并验证异常处理
text.en: Design oversight for those uses and validate abnormal handling

text.zh: 界定允许用途、资料与决定责任
text.en: Define allowed uses, sources and decision ownership

reason.zh: 不知道用途和责任就不能合理设计监督；发布决定须用验证结果，不是先上线再补治理。回看“从设计时纳入治理”。
reason.en: Unknown use and ownership prevent sound oversight design; release requires validation evidence rather than later governance. Revisit Governance by Design.

questions.q: 项目还在功能设计阶段，何时确定数据用途和监督责任？
questions.a: 现在纳入设计并验证
wrong: 等上线发生事故后
等所有功能完成且不再变更时

en.q: When should a project in feature design define data use and oversight ownership?
en.a: Include them now in design and validation
wrong: After a production incident
After every feature is frozen

questions.quote: This does not preclude the use of rapid prototype-and-release development processes, but it does encourage open, transparent iteration.

rationale.zh: 与正式题“模型自称可恢复但无审批”分离：改为授权与验证均已满足后的限定恢复，检查不越范围、不追求虚假零风险。
rationale.en: Separate from the formal model-claim/no-approval case: assess bounded restoration after both approval and validation exist.

misconception.zh: 模型自信表达等于正式授权。
misconception.en: Confident model language counts as formal authorization.

brief.zh: 先阅读本单元，再按题面给定条件操作；角色、数值及流程约束仅用于教材演练，不构成外部法律判断。
brief.en: Read this unit first, then apply the stated case conditions. Roles, values and workflow constraints are exercise assumptions, not external legal determinations.

prompt.zh: 本演练中，获授权的审批员已检查独立修复测试，书面批准仅在原有用途的小批量运行；值班监控和停止通道也已就绪。有人提出两种追加意见：“仍须保证永不出错才可运行”，或“既然批准就可扩大到尚未审查的新用途”。选择与现有证据和批准范围相符的行动。
prompt.en: In this exercise, an authorized approver reviewed independent repair tests and documented approval for a small batch within the existing use. Monitoring and a stop channel are ready. Two proposals are added: require a guarantee of no future error, or expand to an unreviewed use because approval exists. Select actions consistent with the evidence and approval scope.

text.zh: 已有批准可解释为对所有用途永久授权
text.en: Interpret approval as permanent authority for every use

text.zh: 在批准的用途与小批范围内运行，保留监控和停止能力
text.en: Operate within the approved use and batch, retaining monitoring and stop capability

text.zh: 若要新增用途，另核对影响和授权范围
text.en: Reassess impacts and authority before adding a new use

text.zh: 只有承诺永不出错才算人工监督有效
text.en: Effective human oversight requires a promise of no errors ever

reason.zh: 这里的授权和独立验证确已存在，不能继续按“模型自信代审批”的旧事实判断。有效监督是在有依据的范围内行动并保留停止/升级，不是保证零错或无限扩权。回看“人工监督与升级”。
reason.en: Approval and independent validation actually exist in this case. Oversight supports action within an evidenced scope with stop/escalation options, not zero-error guarantees or unlimited authority. Revisit Human Oversight and Escalation.

questions.q: 演练中模型说“我确信可以恢复”，但只有审批员有恢复权限。应该怎么做？
questions.a: 交审批员决定是否恢复
wrong: 接受模型自信声明并恢复
让模型自行签署授权

en.q: The model says it is certain resumption is safe, but only the approver may authorize it. What should happen?
en.a: Ask the approver to decide resumption
wrong: Resume based on confidence
Let the model grant itself authority

questions.quote: Mechanisms are in place and applied, and responsibilities are assigned and understood, to supersede, disengage, or deactivate AI systems that demonstrate performance or outcomes inconsistent with intended use.

rationale.zh: 从总体指标中找出缺失的群体证据。
rationale.en: Detect missing group evidence behind an aggregate metric.

misconception.zh: 总体平均优秀足以证明公平。
misconception.en: A strong overall average proves fairness.

title.en: Fairness and subgroup outcomes: decision lab

brief.zh: 先阅读本单元，再按题面给定条件操作；角色、数值及流程约束仅用于教材演练，不构成外部法律判断。

prompt.zh: 演练：总体错误率5%，但未按受影响群体统计。选择所有必要的下一步；本题不设普遍公平阈值。
prompt.en: Exercise: overall error rate is 5%, with no breakdown for affected groups. Select all necessary next steps; no universal fairness threshold is given.

reason.zh: 需要识别相关群体、比较差错和影响，并讨论取舍；一个总体均值不能给出群体分布。 常见错误：总体平均优秀足以证明公平。 回看《公平性与分组表现》。
reason.en: Identify relevant groups, compare errors and impacts, and discuss trade-offs; an aggregate average cannot reveal group distributions. Common error: A strong overall average proves fairness. Review “Fairness and subgroup outcomes”.

text.zh: 直接宣布不存在公平性问题
text.en: Declare no fairness issue immediately

text.zh: 结合用途识别相关群体
text.en: Identify relevant groups for the use

text.zh: 比较群体差错、机会和影响
text.en: Compare group errors, opportunities and impacts

questions.q: 两组错误差异很大，但总体指标达标。合理结论是什么？
questions.a: 仍需结合用途评估群体影响与取舍
wrong: 总体达标即证明公平
只看样本最多的一组

en.q: Group errors differ substantially while the overall target is met. What follows?
en.a: Assess group impacts and trade-offs for the use case
wrong: Overall success proves fairness
Examine only the largest group

questions.quote: Creating trustworthy AI requires balancing each of these characteristics based on the AI system’s context of use.

rationale.zh: 原题把定义与对应交付物直接写成映射；改用没有类别标签的新界面记录。
rationale.en: The original supplied category mappings; classify unlabeled interface records instead.

misconception.zh: 披露AI参与等同于解释每次判断。
misconception.en: Disclosing AI involvement explains each decision.

brief.en: Read this unit first, then apply the stated case conditions. Roles, values and workflow constraints are exercise assumptions, not external legal determinations.

prompt.zh: 借贷建议工具留下两份界面记录。把每份记录送到它最直接改善的目标；本题不判断该建议是否合法或准确。
prompt.en: A lending-advice tool has two interface records. Route each to the goal it most directly improves; this does not determine legality or accuracy.

text.zh: 帮助理解本次判断依据
text.en: Understand this judgment basis

text.zh: 帮助知情使用系统
text.en: Make an informed choice about system use

text.zh: 页面列出本次建议所用资料，并说明哪些因素改变了建议
text.en: The page identifies sources used for this recommendation and factors that changed it

text.zh: 使用前提示会有AI参与，说明它不能处理的用途
text.en: Before use, the page discloses AI participation and excluded uses

reason.zh: 第一份解释具体行为依据，第二份披露参与和限制；只出现AI标识仍不能解释一次判断。回看“可说明性与透明度”。
reason.en: The first explains a decision basis; the second discloses participation and limits. An AI badge alone does not explain a judgment. Revisit Explainability and Transparency.

questions.q: 页面只写“本服务使用AI”，还缺什么才能帮助理解一次建议？
questions.a: 解释该次建议的判断依据
wrong: 把AI提示字体放大
隐去适用边界

en.q: A page only says the service uses AI. What helps users understand a particular recommendation?
en.a: Explain the basis of that recommendation
wrong: Enlarge the AI notice
Hide the usage boundaries

rationale.zh: 依据控制目的而不是技术名称定位责任缺口。
rationale.en: Locate control gaps by purpose rather than technology names.

misconception.zh: 有访问密码就解决所有隐私和稳健性问题。
misconception.en: A password resolves privacy and robustness too.

brief.zh: 先阅读本单元，再按题面给定条件操作；角色、数值及流程约束仅用于教材演练，不构成外部法律判断。
brief.en: Read this unit first, then apply the stated case conditions. Roles, values and workflow constraints are exercise assumptions, not external legal determinations.

prompt.zh: 将三个独立检查路由到最直接的目的；这里按题面关注点分类。
prompt.en: Route three checks by their most direct purpose, using the stated focus.

reason.zh: 资料用途关注隐私，阻止未授权访问关注安全，变化条件下表现关注稳健性。控制可能互补，但目的有区别。 常见错误：有访问密码就解决所有隐私和稳健性问题。 回看《隐私、安全与稳健性》。
reason.en: Appropriate data use concerns privacy, unauthorized access concerns security, and behavior under change concerns robustness. Controls can complement one another but have distinct purposes. Common error: A password resolves privacy and robustness too. Review “Privacy, security and robustness”.

text.zh: 隐私
text.en: Privacy

text.zh: 安全
text.en: Security

text.zh: 稳健性
text.en: Robustness

text.zh: 检查个人资料是否用于适当目的
text.en: Check appropriate personal-data purposes

text.zh: 阻止无权限账号进入资料库
text.en: Block unauthorized accounts from the repository

text.zh: 测试输入异常时能否适当运行
text.en: Test appropriate behavior on unusual inputs

questions.q: 系统限制了账号访问，但从未测试环境变化。哪项仍缺证据？
questions.a: 稳健性
wrong: 已经证明全部责任原则
仅因有密码即可证明稳健

en.q: Accounts are access-controlled, but changing conditions were never tested. What still lacks evidence?
en.a: Robustness
wrong: Every responsibility principle is proven
A password already proves robustness

questions.quote: Creating trustworthy AI requires balancing each of these characteristics based on the AI system’s context of use.

rationale.zh: 补全评审记录中的影响维度，使比例判断可审计。
rationale.en: Complete impact dimensions so proportionality reasoning can be reviewed.

misconception.zh: 只记录收益，不记录损害严重性和可逆性。
misconception.en: Benefits are recorded while severity and reversibility are omitted.

title.en: Benefits, impacts and proportionate controls: decision lab

brief.en: Read this unit first, then apply the stated case conditions. Roles, values and workflow constraints are exercise assumptions, not external legal determinations.

prompt.zh: 评审已记录节省时间。选择还应补充的全部信息，以讨论相称控制。
prompt.en: The review records time savings. Select every missing input needed to discuss proportionate controls.

reason.zh: 影响对象、可能性、严重程度、可逆性和决定责任共同支持取舍；厂商品牌不提供这些影响证据。 常见错误：只记录收益，不记录损害严重性和可逆性。 回看《收益、影响与比例原则》。 不可接受风险应依据适用法律、权利保障及场景标准判断，不能仅以业务收益抵扣。
reason.en: Affected people, likelihood, severity, reversibility and decision ownership support the trade-off; a vendor brand provides none of this impact evidence. Common error: Benefits are recorded while severity and reversibility are omitted. Review “Benefits, impacts and proportionate controls”. Assess unacceptable risk against applicable law, rights protections and contextual standards; business benefits alone do not offset it.

text.zh: 只补模型品牌
text.en: Add only the model brand

text.zh: 严重程度与可逆性
text.en: Severity and reversibility

text.zh: 受影响对象及损害可能性
text.en: Affected people and likelihood of harm

text.zh: 控制取舍和决定责任
text.en: Control trade-offs and decision ownership

questions.q: 两种用途收益相同，其中一种损害难以逆转。评审应如何处理？
questions.a: 将可逆性纳入相称控制和取舍记录
wrong: 收益相同所以控制必须相同
忽略损害只比较速度

en.q: Two uses have equal benefits, but harm from one is hard to reverse. What should the review do?
en.a: Include reversibility in proportionate controls and the trade-off record
wrong: Equal benefits require identical controls
Ignore harm and compare only speed

questions.quote: Other dimensions of harm include its possible recurrence and reversibility.

rationale.zh: 删除题干已给答案的排序作为独立任务，改为识别新用途缺失的保障。
rationale.en: Remove answer-supplied ordering as independent proof and identify missing safeguards for a new use.

misconception.zh: 先做功能，验收时只测速度。
misconception.en: Build features first and test only speed at acceptance.

prompt.zh: 原来只起草内部说明的工具，现在准备自动向客户发送影响其服务资格的结论。当前只测了速度。选择所有必须补入设计与验收的工作。
prompt.en: A tool formerly drafted internal notes and will now automatically send conclusions affecting service eligibility. Only speed has been tested. Select all work missing from design and acceptance.

text.zh: 速度达标即可沿用原用途批准
text.en: Keep the original use approval because speed passed

text.zh: 确定人工介入和失败处置，并验证这些条件
text.en: Define human intervention and failure handling and validate them

text.zh: 界定允许与不允许用途，核对使用资料
text.en: Define permitted and prohibited uses and inspect data use

reason.zh: 用途变化需要在设计与验收中落实保障；速度不能说明新影响已受控制。回看“从用途定义开始设置保障”。
reason.en: Changed use needs safeguards in design and acceptance; speed does not show the new impact is controlled. Revisit Safeguards from Use-Case Definition.

questions.q: 设计验收标准时发现高影响操作需要人工介入，应该如何处理？
questions.a: 把介入情形和保障纳入设计及验证
wrong: 只测响应速度
等上线后用户投诉才定义介入

en.q: During acceptance design, a high-impact action needs human intervention. What should happen?
en.a: Include intervention conditions and safeguards in design and validation
wrong: Test only response speed
Define intervention only after complaints

questions.quote: This does not preclude the use of rapid prototype-and-release development processes, but it does encourage open, transparent iteration.

rationale.zh: 检查监督是否具有实际介入能力。
rationale.en: Check whether oversight has practical intervention capacity.

misconception.zh: 安排一个签字人即可构成有效监督。
misconception.en: Assigning a signer creates effective oversight.

title.en: Review capability and escalation triggers: decision lab

prompt.zh: 演练：复核员只能看到结论，必须立即签字且无暂停权。选择所有必要补强。
prompt.en: Case: a reviewer sees only conclusions, must sign immediately, and cannot pause actions. Select all necessary improvements.

reason.zh: 监督需要证据、时间、训练、停止或修改权，并给无来源结论等触发事件指定接手人；单纯签字不提供能力。 常见错误：安排一个签字人即可构成有效监督。 回看《复核能力与升级阈值》。
reason.en: Oversight needs evidence, time, training, stop or modification authority, and owners for triggers such as unsupported conclusions. A signature alone provides no capability. Common error: Assigning a signer creates effective oversight. Review “Review capability and escalation triggers”.

text.zh: 只增加签字次数
text.en: Only require more signatures

text.zh: 授予停止或修改权限

text.zh: 把会议参与名单复制到责任栏即可

Simply assign responsibility to everyone

The accountable reviewer has not made a contextual assessment. The product lead wants to mark risk review passed because the brief is complete. Which recorded states are supported?

text.zh: 仍应把已经有证据的全部字段改成缺失
text.en: Mark all already evidenced fields missing again

text.zh: 审查是否通过仍待有责任的专业判断，不能由材料齐全推定
text.en: Review approval awaits accountable professional judgment; completeness does not imply it

text.zh: 字段填满即证明所有合规风险已排除
text.en: Completed fields prove every compliance risk is excluded

text.zh: 上下文材料已准备，可提交相关责任人核对适用条件
text.en: The context brief is ready for accountable assessment of applicable conditions

reason.zh: 准备好上下文支持开展评估，不等于已经完成评估。既不能把材料齐全自动升级成审查通过，也不应忽略已有证据反复要求同一材料。回看“合规风险识别”。
reason.en: Complete context enables review without completing it. Do not turn a ready brief into approval, or ignore evidence and repeatedly request the same inputs. Revisit Compliance Risk Identification.

让模型口头保证合法

wrong: Keep the conclusion
Ask the model for a verbal legality guarantee

prompt.zh: 本演练系统把三个账号对四类资料全部开放。组织批准的工作只有：接待台答复公众退货政策；核算台核对客户多收款；值守台调查服务超时。资料分级为：退货条款是公开内容；含姓名与金额的发票只可用于获准财务核对；员工薪酬只可用于人事用途；脱敏运行事件只可用于获准运维调查。没有人事任务。勾选修复后应保留的读取组合，不按账号名称猜权限，也不保留与任务无关的访问。
prompt.en: The exercise system gives three accounts access to all four source classes. Approved work is limited to: a reception desk answering public return-policy questions, a reconciliation desk investigating a customer overcharge, and an on-call desk investigating service timeouts. Source classifications are: public return terms; identifiable invoices only for approved financial reconciliation; payroll only for HR purposes; and redacted runtime events only for approved operational investigation. No HR task exists. Select read combinations that should remain after repair, using purpose and source classifications rather than account names or convenience.

text.zh: 接待台：公众政策答复
text.en: Reception: public-policy answers

text.zh: 核算台：客户多收款核对
text.en: Reconciliation: customer overcharge review

text.zh: 值守台：服务超时调查
text.en: On-call: service timeout investigation

text.zh: 退货条款
text.en: Return terms

text.zh: 姓名与金额发票
text.en: Identifiable invoices

text.zh: 员工薪酬
text.en: Payroll

text.zh: 脱敏运行事件
text.en: Redacted runtime events

reason.zh: 退货条款支持公众政策答复；发票支持获准的多收款核对；运行事件支持超时调查。薪酬不服务任何已批准工作，其他交叉访问也没有任务依据；原来全库开放不能作为继续开放的理由。这里要求在资料层执行限制，提示词写“请保密”不能代替它。回看“访问控制与数据安全”。
reason.en: Return terms support public answers, invoices support the approved overcharge check, and runtime events support timeout investigation. Payroll serves no approved task, and other cross-access lacks a work basis. Existing broad access does not justify retaining it. Enforce this at the data layer; a confidentiality prompt is not a substitute. Revisit Access Control and Data Security.

保留权限并让模型承诺

wrong: Only prompt it not to read invoices
Keep access and ask for a promise

text.zh: 完成工作证据
text.en: Evidence of performing work

text.zh: 最终决定责任
text.en: Final decision responsibility

text.zh: 分析员完成验证并提交差错报告供批准者参考
text.en: An analyst completes validation and submits an error report to the approver

text.zh: 业务主管核对报告后决定是否投用，并对结果作出说明
text.en: A business lead reviews the report, decides whether to use the system and answers for the outcome

reason.zh: 产出验证报告是执行；作最终决定并对结果负责是问责。执行者不自动获得发布决定权。回看“负责执行与最终问责”。

questions.a: 业务主管
wrong: 分析员因为做了验证
无需任何人决定

en.q: The analyst validates; the business lead is accountable under the case. Who makes the final deployment decision?
en.a: Business lead
wrong: Analyst because they ran validation
Nobody needs to decide

prompt.en: The original review covered internal drafts in one region. A new version faces customers in another region and uses new personal data. The supplier provides only a generic checklist. What context does the accountable reviewer need?

text.zh: 只要供应商沿用同一模型就无需补资料
text.en: No further context if the supplier retains the same model

reason.en: Use, data, region and organizational responsibility determine review scope. A generic list or unchanged model cannot replace that context. Revisit Use, Data and Applicable Requirements.

questions.q: 资料表已有数据类别却没有使用地区。交专业人员前应如何做？
questions.a: 补充使用地区及其他缺失上下文
wrong: 按任意地区规则宣告合规
把未知地区留空并默认无要求

en.q: The context sheet lists data categories but omits usage locations. What should happen before specialist review?
en.a: Add locations and other missing context
wrong: Declare compliance under an arbitrary location’s rules
Leave locations blank and assume no requirements

rationale.en: Separate from retrieve-everything/redact-later: previously authorized cached results must be checked against revoked current authority.

misconception.zh: 先越权检索再遮盖输出就等于阻止访问。
misconception.en: Masking output after unauthorized retrieval prevents access.

prompt.zh: 本演练缓存保存了某用户上周获准查看的区域报告。今天该区域权限已撤销，新请求没有重新检索，服务准备直接复用缓存。组织规则要求每次资料使用都在该次请求获准范围内。选择能修复这个缺口的行动。
prompt.en: An exercise cache contains regional reports the user was authorized to see last week. That authority is revoked today. A new request performs no retrieval and will reuse the cache directly. Organizational policy limits each use to the current request scope. Select repairs for this gap.

text.zh: 在复用前核对当前身份及允许范围，排除已失去权限的缓存资料
text.en: Check current identity and scope before reuse and exclude cache entries no longer permitted

text.zh: 因为上周合法取过，缓存可以永远绕过当前授权
text.en: Past lawful retrieval lets the cache bypass current authority forever

text.zh: 不重新检索就不属于任何资料访问，无需检查
text.en: Without new retrieval there is no data access to check

text.zh: 只有仍在当前获准范围的资料可继续作为该请求证据
text.en: Only sources within the current allowed scope may support the request

reason.zh: 缓存没有消除资料使用，历史许可也不能证明当前请求获准。控制须在本次取用或行动前生效，而非把缓存当授权旁路。回看“最小权限与检索前过滤”。
reason.en: Caching does not remove data use, and historical permission does not establish current authorization. Enforce controls before present use or action instead of treating the cache as a bypass. Revisit Least Privilege and Pre-Retrieval Filtering.

questions.q: 检索器读取了禁止资料后才遮盖答案，这是否替代检索前授权？
questions.a: 不能，越权检索已经发生
wrong: 可以，只要用户没看到
可以，只要提示词要求保密

en.q: The retriever reads forbidden data and then masks the answer. Does this replace authorization before retrieval?
en.a: No; unauthorized retrieval already happened
wrong: Yes if the user never sees it
Yes if the prompt asks for secrecy

reason.zh: 受影响对象和损害条件变化是重评依据；模型版本没变不能证明用途风险也没变。 回看“按影响分配治理力度：决策演练”和本演练条件。

text.zh: 用途与影响变化
text.en: Use and impact changes

text.zh: 不能单独维持旧结论

text.zh: 结果现在影响客户权益
text.en: Outputs now affect customer interests

text.zh: 模型版本仍相同

questions.q: 模型版本未变，但部署人群与用途改变。应如何处理风险等级？

wrong: 永久保留旧等级
仅比较模型参数数量

wrong: Keep the old grade permanently
Compare only parameter counts

reason.zh: 18÷200×100=9%，不是照抄状态名称。运行指标要按同一口径计算；数字只属于本演练。回看“生产监控与事件处理”。
reason.en: 18/200×100=9%. Computing the operating metric uses a consistent definition rather than a status label. These numbers are exercise data. Revisit Production Monitoring and Incidents.

prompt.zh: 沿用本演练：组织预案规定失败率超过5%要由值班人接手；必要日志仅保留受控事件和版本信息，不能留敏感原文。刚算出的失败率为9%。哪些处置有依据？若已触发紧急回退，立即按原预案执行，不等待本题完成。
prompt.en: In this exercise, the organizational plan requires on-call takeover above 5% failures. Necessary logs retain controlled event/version information rather than sensitive originals. The measured rate is 9%. Which responses are justified? Any triggered urgent rollback follows its existing plan immediately, without waiting for this task.

text.zh: 交值班人接手并调查异常
text.en: Transfer to on-call staff and investigate

text.zh: 维持无人接手并把全部敏感原文写日志

text.zh: 保全必要受控事件标识与版本，限制敏感信息

reason.zh: 9%超过本题预案门槛，需要明确接手；必要证据不等于无限日志。不能以修表、调查或本题作业拖延已触发的紧急控制。回看“生产监控与事件处理”。
reason.en: 9% exceeds the stated trigger and needs an owner; necessary evidence does not mean unlimited logging. Record repair or investigation must not delay triggered urgent controls. Revisit Production Monitoring and Incidents.

删除异常日志避免告警

只保留总体平均

reason.zh: 授权证明处理资料使用条件；用途与有害内容审查处理内容风险；投诉和处置让异常可接手。不能用生成方式或过滤结果冒充授权。 回看“有害内容与知识产权：决策演练”和本演练条件。

text.en: Intended publication context and harmful-content checks

text.en: Complaint channel and incident handover process

questions.a: 生成不免除这些检查
wrong: 模型生成必然无害
模型生成必然无权利限制

en.q: A team skips rights and content reviews because a model generated the material. What is correct?
en.a: Generation does not remove these checks
wrong: Generated content is always harmless
Generated content always has unrestricted rights

rationale.en: Unlike the fluent/no-source formal question, this case supplies verification evidence and contrasts fluent exaggeration with an awkward but supported answer.

misconception.zh: 内容听起来可信就说明可靠。
misconception.en: Plausible language establishes reliability.

prompt.zh: 本演练核验记录写明：24份申请中23份已完成复核，另1份仍待补资料。答复甲写得很顺：“24份已全部复核通过”；答复乙措辞生硬：“23份复核完，1份等资料，不能说全完”。选择目前可保留的事实与改进。
prompt.en: Exercise verification records show 23 of 24 applications reviewed, with one awaiting more material. Fluent answer A says all 24 passed review. Awkward answer B says 23 are reviewed, one awaits material, so not all are done. Select facts and improvements that can be retained.

text.zh: 甲更流畅，因此将24份全通过作为事实
text.en: Use all 24 approved as fact because A is more fluent

text.zh: 保留23份已复核、1份待补的事实边界
text.en: Retain the boundary: 23 reviewed and one awaiting material

text.zh: 资料已找到，所以两种相反说法都可靠
text.en: Both contradictory statements are reliable because a source was found

text.zh: 可以改善乙的表达，但不能把未完成改写成已通过
text.en: Improve B wording without converting unfinished work into approval

reason.zh: 现在不缺资料，问题在于结论是否被记录支持。“完成复核”也不自动等于“通过”。核验事实边界后可改文风，不能用流畅程度覆盖证据。回看“幻觉与可靠性”。
reason.en: A source is present; the issue is claim support. Completed review also does not automatically mean approval. Improve style after preserving the evidence boundary, not instead of checking it. Revisit Hallucination and Reliability.

questions.q: 一段答案很具体且自信，但没有依据。能否直接当可靠事实？
questions.a: 不能，应核验支持并必要时人工复核
wrong: 可以，细节越多越可靠
可以，自信就是依据

en.q: An answer is detailed and confident but unsupported. Can it be treated as reliable fact?
en.a: No; verify support and seek human review as needed
wrong: Yes; detail guarantees reliability
Yes; confidence is evidence

questions.quote: A grounded response adheres closely to the given information, avoiding speculation or fabrication.

rationale.zh: 原题给出控制→调查→恢复再照排；新题让学习者根据持续损害与未验证修复推断行动。
rationale.en: Infer actions from continuing harm and unvalidated repair instead of copying a supplied incident sequence.

misconception.zh: 发现异常后先扩大上线才能获得更多样本。
misconception.en: Expand deployment first to gather more incident samples.

prompt.zh: 自动发送仍在产生明显错误；人工通道可接手，候选修复未经验证，调查所需的最小事件记录已经受控保全。把以下行动安排为可辩护的处置路径。
prompt.en: Automatic sending continues producing clear errors. A human channel can take over, the proposed fix is unvalidated, and necessary minimized event records are preserved under controls. Arrange a defensible response path.

text.zh: 验证恢复条件后决定是否扩大使用
text.en: Validate restoration conditions before deciding expansion

text.zh: 用受控记录调查原因并修复
text.en: Investigate and repair using controlled records

text.zh: 限制受影响自动行动并转交人工通道
text.en: Contain affected automation and route to the human channel

reason.zh: 仍在发生的损害需要先控制；未验证修复不能直接扩大。必要记录须最小化和受控，而非先暴露敏感原文再调查。回看“检测、限制、调查与恢复”。
reason.en: Continuing harm needs containment, and an unvalidated fix cannot justify expansion. Necessary records stay minimized and controlled. Revisit Detection, Containment, Investigation and Recovery.

questions.q: 修复已提交，但尚未验证恢复条件。下一步是什么？
questions.a: 先验证修复与恢复条件
wrong: 立即扩大所有使用
删除旧版本日志

en.q: A repair is submitted but restoration conditions remain unvalidated. What next?
en.a: Validate remediation and restoration conditions first
wrong: Immediately expand to all users
Delete old-version logs

questions.quote: Your recovery processes should be as well exercised as your normal production processes.

rationale.zh: 为差异准备多阶段调查假设，避免一因解释。
rationale.en: Prepare multi-stage hypotheses for disparities instead of assuming a single cause.

misconception.zh: 分组差异一定只来自训练样本。
misconception.en: Subgroup disparities can only come from training samples.

prompt.zh: 演练发现群体差异。选择所有值得调查的可能来源；本题不把任何线索直接判为根因。
prompt.en: A case reveals subgroup disparities. Select every plausible source to investigate; none is declared the root cause here.

reason.zh: 代表性、标注一致性、优化目标和部署人群都可能影响差异，应结合持续监测调查，而不是先锁定一个根因。 常见错误：分组差异一定只来自训练样本。 回看《采样、标注、目标与部署》。 标注分歧可能反映合理的不同观点，应先明确任务与标注规则，不能把统一标签本身当作消除偏差。
reason.en: Representation, labeling consistency, optimization objectives and deployment populations can affect disparities. Investigate with ongoing monitoring rather than assuming one root cause. Common error: Subgroup disparities can only come from training samples. Review “Sampling, labels, objectives and deployment”. Label disagreement can reflect legitimate different perspectives. Clarify the task and labeling rules; uniform labels alone do not eliminate bias.

text.zh: 因总体平均稳定而停止调查
text.en: Stop investigating because the overall average is stable

text.zh: 样本代表性与标注一致性
text.en: Sample representation and label consistency

text.zh: 优化目标与部署人群变化
text.en: Optimization objectives and deployment-population changes

questions.q: 群体差异出现，但样本代表性检查正常。能否结束偏差调查？
questions.a: 不能，还需调查标注、目标和部署等来源
wrong: 能，样本是唯一来源
能，只要总体平均没变

en.q: A subgroup disparity appears despite normal sample-representation checks. Can the bias investigation end?
en.a: No; investigate labeling, objectives and deployment too
wrong: Yes; samples are the only source
Yes if the overall average is unchanged

misconception.zh: 资料有授权就证明生成内容安全。
misconception.en: Licensed inputs prove generated outputs are safe.

prompt.zh: 演练报告只记录“来源有授权，输出未审”。选择所有仍需处理的工作。
prompt.en: The case report says sources are authorized but outputs are unreviewed. Select all remaining work.

reason.zh: 来源授权只回答允许如何使用资料；输出用途、内容风险、投诉与处置仍需核对。反过来，过滤有害内容也不证明获得许可。 常见错误：资料有授权就证明生成内容安全。 回看《来源授权、输出用途与有害内容》。
reason.en: Source permission addresses allowed source use. Output use, content risk, complaints and remediation still need review. Conversely, harmful-content filtering does not prove permission. Common error: Licensed inputs prove generated outputs are safe. Review “Source rights, output uses and harmful content”.

text.zh: 设置投诉与处置流程
text.en: Establish complaints and remediation procedures

text.zh: 直接把来源授权当成输出安全证明
text.en: Treat source authorization as proof of output safety

text.zh: 按输出用途进行内容审核
text.en: Review content for intended output use

questions.q: 输出通过有害内容过滤，却未核对来源许可。可否认定已获版权许可？
questions.a: 不能，内容安全与来源许可是不同检查
wrong: 可以，过滤即代表许可
可以，未发现有害词就足够

en.q: An output passes harmful-content filtering, but source permission is unchecked. Does that prove copyright permission?
en.a: No; content safety and source permission are separate checks
wrong: Yes; filtering implies permission
Yes; no harmful terms is enough

misconception.zh: 看到相关引用就默认支持结论且版本正确。
misconception.en: A related citation automatically supports the claim and has the right version.

prompt.zh: 材料箱有一份旧版政策摘录：“收货后7天内可提出申请”。没有证据说明它仍是现行版本。将三条说法按摘录能支持的范围归档；知识可以回看。
prompt.en: The source chest contains an old policy excerpt: “Requests may be made within 7 days of receipt.” There is no evidence it remains current. Classify three claims by the support available from that excerpt; sources remain accessible.

text.zh: 所给摘录直接支持
text.en: Directly supported by this excerpt

text.zh: 与摘录冲突
text.en: Contradicts the excerpt

text.zh: 尚需其他证据
text.en: Needs additional evidence

text.zh: 这份摘录写的是7天
text.en: This excerpt says 7 days

text.zh: 这份摘录支持承诺30天
text.en: This excerpt supports promising 30 days

text.zh: 今天对所有客户都应承诺7天
text.en: Today all customers should be promised 7 days

reason.zh: 7与30可直接对照；旧摘录不能证明当前适用性。主题相关、有引用或写“已核验”都不能填补版本未知。重要未知应保留并升级复核。回看“证据支持与不确定性”。
reason.en: Seven versus thirty can be compared directly, but an old excerpt does not establish current applicability. Relevance, a citation or a verified label cannot fill the version gap. Preserve important uncertainty and escalate review. Revisit Evidence Support and Uncertainty.

questions.q: 引用主题相关，但是否支持重要结论及版本均未知。应如何表达？
questions.a: 保留不确定性并升级复核支持与版本
wrong: 直接宣布结论已经证实
删除未知标记保持答案流畅

en.q: A citation is topically relevant, but support for an important claim and its version are unknown. What should be communicated?
en.a: Retain uncertainty and escalate support and version checks
wrong: Declare the claim verified
Remove unknown markers for fluent wording

misconception.zh: 只核对模型采购发票
misconception.en: Check only the model invoice

title.zh: 组织准备度

prompt.zh: 团队想用现有获准工具开展一个限定用途的试用。负责人已确认目标与资源，获准资料能取得且质量已核对，员工完成岗位练习，值守与治理责任也已有记录；负责人已批准该限定试用，但尚未采购更新型号。选择对这些证据最合适的处理。
prompt.en: A team proposes a bounded trial using an existing approved tool. Goals and resources are confirmed, authorized sources are available and checked, staff completed role practice, and operating/governance ownership is documented. The accountable owner approved this bounded trial, but no newer model was purchased. Select an appropriate use of this evidence.

text.zh: 没有新采购记录就不能承认任何准备证据
text.en: Without a new purchase, none of the readiness evidence counts

text.zh: 按限定用途与既定验收目标开展受控试用，继续核对实际结果
text.en: Run the bounded controlled trial against its acceptance goals and check actual outcomes

text.zh: 记录这些准备条件只支持当前用途，不自动证明所有用途已准备好
text.en: Record that these conditions support this use, without claiming readiness for every use

text.zh: 准备条件齐全即保证试用一定产生业务收益
text.en: Complete readiness guarantees business benefits

prompt.zh: 本演练数据契约规定order_id唯一。三行记录为：A订单金额50；A订单金额50（同一订单的重复导入）；B订单金额缺失且未核验。仪表盘误写“独立订单3笔，已知订单金额100”。只修正这两个可由现有证据确定的数值；金额单位元。
prompt.en: The exercise contract makes order_id unique. Three rows are: order A amount 50; order A amount 50 (a duplicate import of the same order); order B with an unverified missing amount. The dashboard incorrectly shows 3 distinct orders and a known-order amount of 100. Repair only the two numbers established by the evidence, in currency units.

reason.zh: A的两行只是一笔，B仍是一笔，所以独立订单2；已核验的去重金额只有A的50。B金额缺失不能自动填0，也不能据此宣称完整总额是50。回看“质量维度与数据契约”。
reason.en: The two A rows are one order and B is another, giving 2 orders. Only A contributes a known deduplicated amount of 50. Missing B is not automatically zero, so this is not a confirmed complete total. Revisit Quality Dimensions and Data Contracts.

prompt.zh: 沿用该记录，主管要把50元作为两笔订单的完整总额发布。当前证据允许哪种说明？

text.zh: 缺失自然等于0，因此完整总额已确定50
text.en: Missing naturally means zero, so the complete total is confirmed as 50

text.zh: 只能报告已知去重金额50，完整总额仍因B缺失而未知
text.en: Report known deduplicated amount 50; the complete total remains unknown because B is missing

text.zh: 保留重复A就能抵消缺失B
text.en: Keeping duplicate A offsets missing B

reason.zh: 去重与完整性是不同问题；修复重复不制造缺失证据。需要核验B后才能确认完整总额。回看“质量维度与数据契约”。
reason.en: Deduplication and completeness are distinct. Removing a duplicate does not create missing evidence; verify B before claiming a complete total. Revisit Quality Dimensions and Data Contracts.

prompt.zh: 一线倡导者已演示用法并收集到跨部门需求，但没有权力分配数据维护资源。高层已表达支持，却没有任何人确认预算与协调责任。选择能推进而不越权的工作。
prompt.en: A frontline champion demonstrated use and collected cross-team needs but cannot assign data-maintenance resources. Leaders voice support, yet no one owns funding or coordination. Select work that advances the project without bypassing authority.

text.zh: 倡导者继续把实际需求与试用反馈交给有权决定者
text.en: The champion brings practical needs and trial feedback to authorized decision makers

text.zh: 倡导者因积极就可自行取得其他部门全部数据权限
text.en: The enthusiastic champion grants themselves access to all departmental data

text.zh: 赞助者落实资源与跨部门协调责任
text.en: The sponsor establishes resourcing and cross-team coordination responsibility

reason.zh: 支持口号不等于资源到位；倡导者连接需求与实践，但不能以热情替代授权。两种职责互补而不互相吞并。回看“赞助者与业务倡导者”。
reason.en: Support slogans do not supply resources. Champions connect needs and practice but enthusiasm does not create authority. These roles complement rather than replace one another. Revisit Sponsors and Business Champions.

questions.q: 一线发现需求但缺跨部门资源，应补什么？
questions.a: 赞助者提供资源和协调
wrong: 只增加倡导口号

en.q: Frontline needs are known but cross-team resources are missing. What is needed?
en.a: Sponsor resourcing and coordination
wrong: More advocacy slogans only

questions.quote: Identify key stakeholders, cross-organizational dependencies, key risks, and barriers to transformation.

rationale.zh: 在业务情境中判断下一步，而非复述定义。
rationale.en: Judge the next action in context rather than recite a definition.

misconception.zh: 默认模型自动承担暂停责任
misconception.en: Assume the model owns stop decisions automatically

prompt.zh: 本演练技术交付完成，但没有人有权暂停不适当用途。下一步？
prompt.en: The exercise implementation is done, but nobody can pause inappropriate use. What next?

reason.zh: 角色机制必须覆盖交付和停止，不只是实现任务；回看“业务、技术与监督角色”。
reason.en: Role design must cover delivery and stopping authority, not implementation alone. Revisit Business, technical and oversight roles.

text.zh: 默认模型自动承担暂停责任
text.en: Assume the model owns stop decisions automatically

text.zh: 明确监督角色、暂停权限、交付标准和接手关系
text.en: Define oversight, stop authority, acceptance criteria and handover responsibilities

questions.q: 团队名单齐全但异常无人接手，什么仍未落实？
questions.a: 明确监督角色、暂停权限、交付标准和接手关系
wrong: 默认模型自动承担暂停责任

en.q: The team list is complete but nobody accepts incidents. What remains missing?
en.a: Define oversight, stop authority, acceptance criteria and handover responsibilities
wrong: Assume the model owns stop decisions automatically

questions.quote: Risk management should be continuous, timely, and performed throughout the AI system lifecycle dimensions.

rationale.zh: 与正式题无收益证据却承诺上涨分离：已测到正负混合结果，考查完整沟通而非挑选有利证据。
rationale.en: Unlike the formal unverified-benefit promise, mixed positive and negative results are measured; assess complete communication rather than selective reporting.

misconception.zh: 为提高采用率保留无依据收益承诺
misconception.en: Keep unsupported benefit promises to increase adoption

prompt.zh: 本演练已验证：一轮试用中答复差错减少，但平均处理时间变长；长期净收益尚未测得。员工还需要了解新的复核职责。宣传稿只保留差错改善并写“所有人都会更轻松”。选择可发布的修订方向。
prompt.en: The exercise verified fewer response errors but longer average handling time during one trial; long-term net benefits remain unmeasured. Staff also need to understand new review duties. A notice keeps only the error improvement and says every role becomes easier. Select defensible revisions.

text.zh: 有处理变慢就删除已经验证的质量改善
text.en: Slower handling means deleting the verified quality improvement

text.zh: 因为有一个好指标就能承诺所有岗位更轻松
text.en: One favorable metric supports an easier-work promise for every role

text.zh: 同时说明已验证的差错改善和处理变慢，不隐去不利结果
text.en: Report both verified error improvement and slower handling without hiding the drawback

text.zh: 明确长期结果未知、新复核职责与支持反馈安排
text.en: State unknown long-term outcomes, new review duties, support and feedback

reason.zh: 透明沟通既不夸大也不抹掉证据：同一轮可同时有收益与代价。已知结果、未知长期影响、岗位变化和支持都应明确。回看“事实、未知、岗位影响与反馈”。
reason.en: Transparent communication neither exaggerates nor erases evidence: a trial may have benefits and costs together. State known results, unknown long-term effects, role changes and support. Revisit Facts, Uncertainty, Role Impacts and Feedback.

questions.q: 领导要求宣传尚未证实的岗位收益，应如何沟通？
questions.a: 区分已验证与未验证结果，说明岗位变化、支持与反馈
wrong: 为提高采用率保留无依据收益承诺

en.q: Leadership requests an unverified role-benefit claim. How should the team communicate?
en.a: Distinguish verified and unverified results and explain role changes, support and feedback
wrong: Keep unsupported benefit promises to increase adoption

questions.quote: Over-promising can hurt perceptions of the AI service.

rationale.zh: 原题把改进路径完整给出，换为根据三种不同障碍配置干预。
rationale.en: Replace the fully supplied improvement path with matching interventions to three distinct blockers.

misconception.zh: 禁止报告问题，只统计积极反馈
misconception.en: Ban issue reports and count only positive feedback

title.zh: 安全练习反馈闭环

prompt.zh: 同一部门三位同事解释为何不采用工具。按实际障碍选择首要支持方向；不把所有疑问归为抵触，也不收集敏感原文。
prompt.en: Three colleagues explain non-adoption. Choose the first support direction from the actual blocker; do not label every concern resistance or collect sensitive originals.

text.zh: 核查控制与风险
text.en: Inspect controls and risk

text.zh: 限定范围安全练习
text.en: Bounded safe practice

text.zh: 核对工具与流程适配
text.en: Check tool/workflow fit

text.zh: 担心真实客户资料会被送到未批准服务
text.en: Worries that real customer data will go to an unapproved service

text.zh: 获准练习也不敢试，害怕错误导致惩罚
text.en: Avoids even approved practice for fear of punishment

text.zh: 试用后发现工具无法处理本岗位必需格式
text.en: Finds the tool cannot handle a format required by the role

reason.zh: 资料风险需检查控制；怕失败需安全练习和反馈；格式障碍需检查适配。不同原因不应一律培训或强制使用。回看“安全试验与问题反馈”。
reason.en: Data risk needs control review, fear needs safe practice and feedback, and format failure needs fit assessment. Different blockers do not all call for training or mandates. Revisit Safe Experimentation and Issue Reporting.

questions.q: 不愿采用可能由工具不适配导致，管理者应怎样回应？
questions.a: 提供限定练习、问题报告与改进渠道，调查真实障碍
wrong: 禁止报告问题，只统计积极反馈

en.q: Reluctance may reflect poor tool fit. How should a manager respond?
en.a: Provide bounded practice, reporting and improvement channels and investigate the blocker
wrong: Ban issue reports and count only positive feedback

questions.quote: Members of this team are able to bring up problems and tough issues.

rationale.zh: 与正式题客服只会操作但不能处理政策未知分离：员工已展示判断，考查表现证据与组织正式认定的边界。
rationale.en: Unlike the formal tool-fluent but unprepared employee, performance is demonstrated; distinguish that evidence from formal organizational approval.

misconception.zh: 只考按钮位置记忆
misconception.en: Test button-position recall only

title.zh: 从会操作到能判断

prompt.zh: 岗位演练记录显示，员工能在两个新任务中核对来源、识别边界并正确升级给接手人。但组织尚未指定谁评估、用什么通过标准作正式岗位胜任认定。有人提议仅按出勤次数发证，也有人想套用一张通用框架作组织正式量表。如何处理已有证据与认定？这里说的是岗位认定，不改变本游戏90%测验门槛。
prompt.en: Role exercises show the employee verified sources, recognized boundaries and escalated correctly in two new tasks. The organization has not named an assessor or pass criteria for formal role competence. One proposal certifies by attendance; another adopts a generic framework as an approved organizational rubric. How should evidence and approval be handled? This concerns role approval, not the game 90% exam threshold.

text.zh: 未经组织确认的通用框架天然等于正式认定量表
text.en: An unapproved generic framework automatically is the formal competence rubric

text.zh: 保留已经展示的真实任务表现，交指定评估者按明确标准认定
text.en: Preserve demonstrated task performance for a designated assessor using explicit criteria

text.zh: 补齐评估者、证据要求、通过标准和接手责任
text.en: Define assessors, evidence requirements, pass criteria and handover ownership

text.zh: 真实表现可以忽略，出勤次数越多必然越胜任
text.en: Ignore performance because more attendance necessarily proves competence

reason.zh: 已有实际表现值得保留，但正式岗位认定还需有责任的评估与明确标准。不能退回只数签到，也不能把通用框架自动当作组织批准。回看“从会操作到能判断”。
reason.en: Demonstrated performance is evidence, while formal role approval needs accountable assessment and explicit criteria. Do not revert to attendance counts or assume a generic framework is approved. Revisit From Tool Operation to Judgment.

questions.q: 操作熟练的客服遇到政策未知，应考查哪种能力？
questions.a: 实做政策核验、边界识别和升级交接
wrong: 只考按钮位置记忆

en.q: A fluent tool user faces unknown policy. What ability should be assessed?
en.a: Demonstrate policy verification, boundary recognition and escalation handover
wrong: Test button-position recall only

questions.quote: It links learning to real tasks and real decisions.

rationale.zh: 原任务再次重复投诉草稿核验/发送；改为重复性指标与具体后果冲突时能否授权维修调度，观察责任证据判断。
rationale.en: Replace another complaint-draft check/send task with an authority decision when repetitive repair prioritization conflicts with consequences.

misconception.zh: 因为已起草就自动取消人工责任
misconception.en: Remove human accountability because a draft exists

title.zh: 判断、同理心与责任

brief.en: Read all foundation cards in this section before applying them. Exercise conditions are not universal scores or policies. Enter formal practice after completing the chapter.

prompt.zh: 维修系统每天都给工单排序。新方案按历史出现频率自动承诺到场时间，却没有比较不同故障的实际后果，也未说明谁有权批准承诺。例如较少出现的故障仍可能使某位住户失去必要服务。这里没有给出具体优先级政策。选择当前证据支持的决定，不需要自行发明“哪一户必须先修”的规则。
prompt.en: A repair system ranks tickets daily. A proposal would automatically promise arrival times using historical frequency, without comparing consequences or identifying who may authorize commitments. An infrequent failure might still deprive a resident of an essential service. No priority policy is supplied. Select decisions supported by the evidence without inventing a rule for which resident must be served first.

text.zh: 排序每天重复，所以系统自动获得承诺到场时间的权限
text.en: Daily repetition automatically grants the system authority to promise arrival times

text.zh: 直接发明一条未获批准的住户优先级规则并自动执行
text.en: Invent and automatically execute an unapproved resident-priority rule

text.zh: 系统可继续整理工单作为辅助，但频率本身不构成自动承诺授权
text.en: The system may assist by organizing tickets, but frequency alone does not authorize commitments

text.zh: 先由负责人核验不同故障后果并明确承诺权限，记录取舍
text.en: Have an accountable person check consequences, establish commitment authority and record trade-offs

reason.zh: 重复性说明可能存在辅助自动化机会，不能替代后果证据、价值取舍或正式授权。当前缺少优先级政策，应明确责任与条件，而非从频率或同情心直接造一条普遍调度规则。回看“判断、同理心与责任”。
reason.en: Repetition may suggest an assistance opportunity, but it does not replace consequence evidence, value judgments or formal authority. Missing policy calls for accountable conditions, not an invented universal dispatch rule based on frequency or sympathy. Revisit Judgment, Empathy and Responsibility.

questions.q: 任务部分自动化后，最终责任应怎样处理？
questions.a: 人核验、理解处境并承担授权决定
wrong: 因为已起草就自动取消人工责任

en.q: After partial task automation, how should accountability be handled?
en.a: A person verifies, understands circumstances and owns authorization
wrong: Remove human accountability because a draft exists

questions.quote: These could include leveraging human skills such as critical thinking; creativity, innovation and entrepreneurship; and empathy

rationale.zh: 原阶段排列接近复述常识；用实验失败与资源已投入的冲突检验迭代决定。
rationale.en: Replace near-recall stage ordering with an iteration decision despite prior investment.

misconception.zh: 无视反馈一次替换全部流程
misconception.en: Ignore feedback and replace all workflows

title.zh: 迭代式转型

brief.zh: 先阅读本节全部基础知识卡，再逐项完成应用；本演练条件不代表通用评分或制度。整章交付后进入正式练习。
brief.en: Read all foundation cards in this section before applying them. Exercise conditions are not universal scores or policies. Enter formal practice after completing the chapter.

prompt.zh: 团队为内部助手做完小规模实验，结果发现资料过期使答案无法核验，但扩展预算已经批准。此时什么行动能体现迭代式转型？
prompt.en: A small internal-assistant experiment finds sources too outdated to verify answers, but expansion funding was already approved. Which action demonstrates iterative transformation?

text.zh: 返回修复资料与验证假设，再决定下一阶段
text.en: Return to source repair and hypothesis validation before deciding the next stage

text.zh: 按原日期扩展，因为阶段不能倒退
text.en: Expand on schedule because stages cannot go backward

text.zh: 只给阶段改名，不处理实验发现
text.en: Rename the stage without addressing the finding

reason.zh: 实验的意义是提供继续、返回或停止的证据；批准预算不能替代资料条件。回看“迭代式转型”。
reason.en: Experiments provide evidence to continue, return or stop. Approved funding does not replace source readiness. Revisit Iterative Transformation.

questions.q: 实验发现条件不满足，如何体现迭代？
questions.a: 依据反馈回补条件再决定推进
wrong: 无视反馈一次替换全部流程

en.q: An experiment finds unmet conditions. How should iteration work?
en.a: Use feedback to repair conditions before progressing
wrong: Ignore feedback and replace all workflows

questions.quote: This does not preclude the use of rapid prototype-and-release development processes, but it does encourage open, transparent iteration.

rationale.zh: 在业务情境中判断下一步，而非复述定义。
rationale.en: Judge the next action in context rather than recite a definition.

misconception.zh: 直接复制试点并宣布所有团队适用
misconception.en: Copy the pilot and declare it suitable everywhere

title.zh: 从短期成果到扩展

brief.zh: 先阅读本节全部基础知识卡，再逐项完成应用；本演练条件不代表通用评分或制度。整章交付后进入正式练习。
brief.en: Read all foundation cards in this section before applying them. Exercise conditions are not universal scores or policies. Enter formal practice after completing the chapter.

prompt.zh: 本演练志愿者团队成功，其他部门数据与支持未知。接下来？
prompt.en: An exercise volunteer pilot succeeds; other teams data and support are unknown. What next?

reason.zh: 小范围结果不能证明条件能迁移，需要逐项检查；回看“从短期成果到扩展”。
reason.en: A small result does not prove transferable conditions; inspect them explicitly. Revisit From quick wins to scale.

text.zh: 核验初始成果并检查新团队数据、流程和支持的迁移条件
text.en: Verify the initial result and check new-team data, workflow and support transfer conditions

text.zh: 直接复制试点并宣布所有团队适用
text.en: Copy the pilot and declare it suitable everywhere

questions.q: 试点成果可核验，但新部门流程不同，应怎样扩展？
questions.a: 核验初始成果并检查新团队数据、流程和支持的迁移条件
wrong: 直接复制试点并宣布所有团队适用

en.q: Pilot outcomes are verified, but a new department has a different workflow. How should rollout proceed?
en.a: Verify the initial result and check new-team data, workflow and support transfer conditions
wrong: Copy the pilot and declare it suitable everywhere

questions.quote: Limitations of the generalizability beyond the conditions under which the technology was developed are documented.

rationale.zh: 诊断不同职责或条件，避免一个措施解决所有问题。
rationale.en: Diagnose distinct responsibilities or conditions rather than apply one remedy to everything.

misconception.zh: 将所有业务责任移交COE
misconception.en: Transfer all business accountability to the CoE

title.zh: 卓越中心 COE

brief.zh: 先阅读本节全部基础知识卡，再逐项完成应用；本演练条件不代表通用评分或制度。整章交付后进入正式练习。
brief.en: Read all foundation cards in this section before applying them. Exercise conditions are not universal scores or policies. Enter formal practice after completing the chapter.

prompt.zh: 本演练将两项责任分到COE或业务团队。
prompt.en: Allocate the two exercise responsibilities to the CoE or business team.

reason.zh: 集中共享能力不消除业务责任；回看“卓越中心 COE”。
reason.en: Shared capability does not erase business accountability. Revisit Center of excellence (CoE).

text.zh: COE共享支持
text.en: CoE shared support

text.zh: 业务团队责任
text.en: Business team accountability

text.zh: 提供复用的评估方法
text.en: Provide reusable evaluation methods

text.zh: 确认本业务用例的价值与结果
text.en: Own the business use-case value and outcomes

questions.q: 有了COE，业务团队还需要做什么？
questions.a: 承担本用例的业务价值和责任
wrong: 将所有业务责任移交COE

en.q: With a CoE in place, what must business teams still do?
en.a: Own their use-case value and accountability
wrong: Transfer all business accountability to the CoE

questions.quote: Let frontline teams own delivery and implementation while forums provide policy and oversight.

rationale.zh: 与正式题账号增长但结果未知分离：采用人数持平而已验证结果改善，考查不能只按采用指标否定价值。
rationale.en: Unlike the formal account-growth/no-outcome case, adoption is flat while measured outcomes improve; avoid rejecting value from adoption alone.

misconception.zh: 只按账号开通数宣布长期价值
misconception.en: Declare long-term value from account counts alone

title.zh: 持续反馈与价值跟踪

brief.zh: 先阅读本节全部基础知识卡，再逐项完成应用；本演练条件不代表通用评分或制度。整章交付后进入正式练习。

prompt.zh: 本演练本期使用人数与上期相同，但同口径复核发现差错减少、处理成本下降，风险事件也没有增加；尚无足够时间证明长期效果。负责人因账号数没涨要把本期标成“完全没有价值”。选择有依据的反馈。
prompt.en: Exercise user count is unchanged, but comparable review finds fewer errors, lower processing cost and no rise in risk incidents. Long-term effects are not established. The owner wants to label the period no value at all because account count did not grow. Select evidence-based feedback.

text.zh: 记录本期已验证的质量和成本改善，不被账号单一指标抹掉
text.en: Retain verified quality and cost improvements rather than erase them with one account metric

text.zh: 人数没增长就足以证明所有业务改善无效
text.en: No user growth proves every business improvement invalid

text.zh: 本期改善就证明所有长期价值和风险已确定
text.en: This period improvement establishes every long-term value and risk outcome

text.zh: 继续检查采用障碍与长期结果，再据反馈调整计划
text.en: Continue examining adoption barriers and longer-term outcomes to adapt the plan

reason.zh: 采用、结果、风险和成本是互补观察。账号不增不能否定已测改善；一个期间的改善也不等于长期结论已经充分。回看“持续反馈与价值跟踪”。
reason.en: Adoption, outcomes, risk and cost are complementary observations. Flat accounts do not erase measured gains, while one period does not establish long-term conclusions. Revisit Continuous Feedback and Value Tracking.

questions.q: 账号开通多但业务价值未知，反馈体系该怎样补齐？
questions.a: 补齐质量、风险、成本与业务结果并修订计划
wrong: 只按账号开通数宣布长期价值

en.q: Many accounts exist but business value is unknown. How should feedback improve?
en.a: Collect quality, risk, cost and outcomes and revise the plan
wrong: Declare long-term value from account counts alone

questions.quote: best practices for understanding actual benefits and risks in operation

rationale.zh: 原活动按卡片“已有/没有”文字抄分类，改为评价证据是否实际证明生产条件。
rationale.en: Replace copying available/missing words with assessing whether evidence actually establishes production readiness.

misconception.zh: 直接公开演示页面即算生产交付
misconception.en: Publish the demo and call it production handover

prompt.zh: 评审收到了三份“生产准备材料”。判断每份是否已证明其声称的条件，不只看文件标题。
prompt.en: A review receives three production-readiness submissions. Judge whether each establishes the condition it claims, rather than trust its title.

text.zh: 已有可核验证据
text.en: Verifiable evidence is present

text.zh: 尚缺关键验证
text.en: A key validation gap remains

text.zh: 值班表上的人员已确认接手，并在告警演练中成功接收与处理
text.en: Named on-call staff accepted ownership and successfully received and handled an alert drill

text.zh: 文件名叫“回退已准备”，但恢复路径从未执行过
text.en: A document is called Fallback Ready, but its recovery route has never been exercised

text.zh: 演示页面能打开，因此报告宣称已证明全天运维能力
text.en: A demo page opens, so the report claims continuous operating capability

reason.zh: 实际接手演练支持相应条件；文件标题或可打开页面不证明恢复和持续运维。转生产要分别核验责任、运行与异常处置。回看“试点转生产”。
reason.en: A takeover drill supports its condition. A title or working page does not demonstrate recovery or sustained operations. Production needs separate evidence of ownership, operations and incident handling. Revisit Pilot-to-Production Transition.

questions.q: 演示验收通过后，怎样判断可否转生产？
questions.a: 明确责任、运维、治理、支持和异常处置
wrong: 直接公开演示页面即算生产交付

en.q: After demo acceptance, how should production readiness be judged?
en.a: Establish ownership, operations, governance, support and incident handling
wrong: Publish the demo and call it production handover

questions.quote: Monitor and maintain generative AI applications in production.

rationale.zh: 在业务情境中判断下一步，而非复述定义。
rationale.en: Judge the next action in context rather than recite a definition.

misconception.zh: 为赶进度忽略资料和支持差异
misconception.en: Ignore data and support differences to meet the schedule

title.zh: 全企业推广

brief.zh: 先阅读本节全部基础知识卡，再逐项完成应用；本演练条件不代表通用评分或制度。整章交付后进入正式练习。
brief.en: Read all foundation cards in this section before applying them. Exercise conditions are not universal scores or policies. Enter formal practice after completing the chapter.

prompt.zh: 本演练新部门的资料不足，推广进度已排好。选处置。
prompt.en: A new exercise department lacks data but rollout is scheduled. Select an action.

reason.zh: 跨团队差异、连续性和支持能力需要重新核验；回看“全企业推广”。
reason.en: Cross-team differences, continuity and support need revalidation. Revisit Enterprise rollout.

text.zh: 为赶进度忽略资料和支持差异
text.en: Ignore data and support differences to meet the schedule

text.zh: 暂停该用途并补条件，按证据调整推广节奏
text.en: Pause that use, repair conditions and adjust rollout pace by evidence

questions.q: 推广中发现新团队条件不足，怎样保留纠正空间？
questions.a: 暂停该用途并补条件，按证据调整推广节奏
wrong: 为赶进度忽略资料和支持差异

en.q: During rollout a new team lacks prerequisites. How can the plan preserve correction options?
en.a: Pause that use, repair conditions and adjust rollout pace by evidence
wrong: Ignore data and support differences to meet the schedule

questions.quote: Make sure that generative AI models can only retrieve information that the user is authorized to access.

rationale.zh: 原题按定义顺序重排，改为对实际成果选择阶段动作而非背阶段词。
rationale.en: Replace definition-order recall with choosing stage actions from actual outcomes.

misconception.zh: 阶段不可回头所以强行上线
misconception.en: Force launch because stages cannot be revisited

title.zh: 构想、实验、启动与扩展

brief.zh: 先阅读本节全部基础知识卡，再逐项完成应用；本演练条件不代表通用评分或制度。整章交付后进入正式练习。
brief.en: Read all foundation cards in this section before applying them. Exercise conditions are not universal scores or policies. Enter formal practice after completing the chapter.

prompt.zh: 三个项目留下不同证据。把每个项目送往目前最需要的工作，而不是按预算大小决定。以下不构成统一成熟度认证。
prompt.en: Three projects have different evidence. Route each to the work it currently needs rather than decide by budget. This is not a universal maturity certification.

text.zh: 明确问题与假设
text.en: Clarify problem and assumptions

text.zh: 补齐生产运行条件
text.en: Establish production operating conditions

text.zh: 验证更多团队的迁移条件
text.en: Validate transfer to additional teams

text.zh: 只确定要做AI，尚未说清业务问题
text.en: Only a desire to use AI exists, with no business problem

text.zh: 实验价值已验证，但无值守与回退安排
text.en: Experimental value is verified, but operations and rollback are undefined

text.zh: 当前团队稳定使用，新部门资料和支持条件不同
text.en: The current team operates steadily, while new departments differ in data and support

reason.zh: 阶段由缺什么证据决定：问题不明不能直接实验；实验成功不等于生产准备；稳定运行不自动证明新团队适用。回看“构想、实验、启动与扩展”。
reason.en: Stage work follows missing evidence: an unclear problem blocks useful experiments, pilot success is not production readiness, and stable operation does not establish transfer. Revisit Envision, Experiment, Launch and Scale.

questions.q: 实验发现资料不可用，下一步合适做法是什么？
questions.a: 回补资料条件并重新验证
wrong: 阶段不可回头所以强行上线

en.q: An experiment finds sources unusable. What is an appropriate next step?
en.a: Repair source conditions and validate again
wrong: Force launch because stages cannot be revisited

questions.quote: This does not preclude the use of rapid prototype-and-release development processes, but it does encourage open, transparent iteration.

rationale.zh: 与正式题新部门缺少专家支持分离：任务、资料和支持条件已有匹配证据，考查按条件分批验证而非按参与者身份否决。
rationale.en: Unlike the formal new-team expert-support gap, matching tasks, sources and support are evidenced; validate in batches instead of rejecting by participant identity.

misconception.zh: 仅复制试点配置作为迁移证明
misconception.en: Use a copied pilot configuration as proof of transferability

title.zh: 试点代表性与迁移条件

brief.zh: 先阅读本节全部基础知识卡，再逐项完成应用；本演练条件不代表通用评分或制度。整章交付后进入正式练习。
brief.en: Read all foundation cards in this section before applying them. Exercise conditions are not universal scores or policies. Enter formal practice after completing the chapter.

prompt.zh: 本演练新团队与原试点任务相同，获准资料已核对，员工练习达到已定义要求，支持人员和成本安排也经核验。负责人已批准小批验证并设置暂停点，但未批准全量推广。有人因为“他们不是原来那批志愿者”要求永久停止，也有人要立即取消暂停点。选择符合证据的方案。
prompt.en: The exercise new team has the same task as the pilot, checked authorized sources, staff meeting defined practice requirements and verified support/cost arrangements. The owner approved a small validation batch with pause points, not full rollout. One person demands permanent rejection because they are not the original volunteers; another wants to remove pause points. Select an evidence-consistent plan.

text.zh: 若新证据显示条件不同，重新核对并调整节奏
text.en: Reassess and adjust pace if new evidence shows changed conditions

text.zh: 在获准小批范围运行并检查实际迁移表现，保留暂停点
text.en: Run the authorized small batch, inspect actual transfer performance and retain pause points

text.zh: 只因不是原试点参与者就无视匹配证据永久否决
text.en: Permanently reject matching evidence solely because participants differ

text.zh: 条件看起来相同就可跳过小批验证并全量开放
text.en: Apparently matching conditions permit skipping the batch and opening everything

reason.zh: 迁移依据是任务、资料、能力与支持条件，不是同一批人的身份。条件匹配支持受控验证，不保证所有规模都适用；暂停点仍提供纠正空间。回看“试点代表性与迁移条件”。
reason.en: Transfer depends on tasks, sources, capability and support rather than participant identity. Matching conditions support controlled validation without proving every scale; pause points preserve correction options. Revisit Pilot Representativeness and Transfer Conditions.

questions.q: 新部门缺少试点的专家支持，应如何解释试点结果？
questions.a: 核对任务、资源、成本与能力差异，分批验证并留暂停点
wrong: 仅复制试点配置作为迁移证明

en.q: A new department lacks the pilot expert support. How should pilot evidence be interpreted?
en.a: Check task, resource, cost and skill differences, validate in batches and keep pause points
wrong: Use a copied pilot configuration as proof of transferability

questions.quote: Limitations of the generalizability beyond the conditions under which the technology was developed are documented.

rationale.zh: 原分类与COE概览重复，改为处理共享评估与本地过期资料相互推责的故障。
rationale.en: Replace repeated CoE role sorting with a failure involving shared evaluation and stale local sources.

misconception.zh: COE自动承担全部业务决策
misconception.en: The CoE automatically owns every business decision

title.zh: COE与业务责任

brief.zh: 先阅读本节全部基础知识卡，再逐项完成应用；本演练条件不代表通用评分或制度。整章交付后进入正式练习。
brief.en: Read all foundation cards in this section before applying them. Exercise conditions are not universal scores or policies. Enter formal practice after completing the chapter.

prompt.zh: COE提供的检索评估方法已被复用，但某部门使用过期政策产生了错误答案。双方都说“平台是对方负责”，准备关闭问题。选择能保留责任的处理。
prompt.en: A department reused the CoE retrieval-evaluation method but stale local policy caused an incorrect answer. Both sides say the other owns the platform and plan to close the issue. Select responses preserving accountability.

text.zh: 共享方法通过测试，所以所有部门资料自动正确
text.en: A tested shared method makes every departmental source correct

text.zh: COE帮助复用评估方法与经验，但不替代本部门用途责任
text.en: The CoE supports evaluation methods and shared learning without replacing departmental use accountability

text.zh: 业务团队修复本地资料有效性并核验本用例结果
text.en: The business team repairs local source validity and checks its use-case outcomes

reason.zh: 共享方法有效不证明本地资料有效；业务仍对用途与资料负责，COE提供共同能力和支持。不能用平台归属回避实际故障责任。回看“COE与业务责任”。
reason.en: An effective shared method does not establish local source validity. Business retains use/source ownership while the CoE provides shared capability and support. Platform ownership does not remove incident responsibility. Revisit CoE and Business Accountability.

questions.q: 共享平台已上线，部门资料有效性应由谁负责？
questions.a: 业务团队保留用例与资料责任
wrong: COE自动承担全部业务决策

en.q: A shared platform is live. Who retains departmental source-validity responsibility?
en.a: Business teams retain use-case and source accountability
wrong: The CoE automatically owns every business decision

questions.quote: Let frontline teams own delivery and implementation while forums provide policy and oversight.

rationale.zh: 原题与持续反馈概览同为“使用高还看成本”，改用新期间真实数值检查净结果。
rationale.en: Replace repetition of the adoption/cost overview with numerical evidence from a new period.

misconception.zh: 只保留成功案例并宣布持续价值
misconception.en: Keep only success stories and declare sustained value

title.zh: 采用、质量、风险、成本与结果
title.en: Adoption, quality, risk, cost and outcomes

brief.zh: 先阅读本节全部基础知识卡，再逐项完成应用；本演练条件不代表通用评分或制度。整章交付后进入正式练习。
brief.en: Read all foundation cards in this section before applying them. Exercise conditions are not universal scores or policies. Enter formal practice after completing the chapter.

prompt.zh: 本演练本月实际兑现的业务收益为100万元，同期运行支出40万元、人工复核支出70万元；使用人数翻倍。只按这些给定现金数据填写总支出和收益减去支出的差额，不推断长期ROI或人员裁减。
prompt.en: This exercise month realizes benefits of 100 ten-thousand currency units, with operating spending 40 and human-review spending 70 in the same units in the same period; users doubled. Enter total spending and benefits minus spending from these cash figures only. Do not infer long-term ROI or workforce reduction.

reason.zh: 总支出40+70=110，100−110=−10。使用人数翻倍不把负差额自动变成持续价值；还需核对质量、风险和未来条件，不可只保留成功故事。回看“采用、质量、风险、成本与结果”。
reason.en: Spending is 40+70=110 and the difference is 100−110=−10. Doubled usage does not turn the negative difference into sustained value. Quality, risk and future conditions still need examination. Revisit Adoption, Quality, Risk, Cost and Outcomes.

questions.q: 使用率提高但复核成本激增，应该如何反馈？
questions.a: 结合结果、风险与成本重新评估并改进流程
wrong: 只保留成功案例并宣布持续价值

en.q: Adoption rises but review costs surge. What feedback action is appropriate?
en.a: Reassess outcomes, risks and costs and improve the workflow
wrong: Keep only success stories and declare sustained value

questions.quote: best practices for understanding actual benefits and risks in operation

rationale.zh: 与正式题模型已交付但告警无人接分离：接手和回退均已演练，问题变为验证后版本改变却沿用旧结论。
rationale.en: Unlike the formal delivered-file/unowned-alert case, takeover and rollback were drilled; the gap is reusing old conclusions after a version change.

misconception.zh: 再次复制模型文件作为完整交接
misconception.en: Copy the model file again as a complete handover

title.zh: 生产交接包组装

brief.zh: 先阅读本节全部基础知识卡，再逐项完成应用；本演练条件不代表通用评分或制度。整章交付后进入正式练习。
brief.en: Read all foundation cards in this section before applying them. Exercise conditions are not universal scores or policies. Enter formal practice after completing the chapter.

prompt.zh: 生产交接时，值守、告警接手、运行手册和回退演练都已通过。之后模型和资料版本同时更新，功能行为可能改变；变更单却只附旧版演练记录并写“交接曾通过，无需复核”。现有负责人仍愿意接手。选择这次变更需补的工作。
prompt.en: Operations, alert takeover, runbooks and rollback drills passed handover. The model and source versions then changed, potentially affecting behavior. The change record includes only old drill evidence and says no review is needed because handover once passed. Existing owners still accept responsibility. Select work missing for this change.

text.zh: 把新版本与变更影响明确记录，按影响验证运行、告警和回退条件
text.en: Record the new versions and impacts and validate relevant operating, alert and rollback conditions

text.zh: 由现有负责人接收更新后的运行与资料维护安排
text.en: Have existing owners accept updated operating and source-maintenance arrangements

text.zh: 不检查变更，先把已明确的负责人一律改成无人负责
text.en: Ignore the change and relabel every established owner missing

text.zh: 无需补验证，因为任何旧版演练都永久覆盖所有新版本
text.en: No validation is needed because an old drill permanently covers every new version

reason.zh: 交接通过不是对未来所有版本的永久证明；新模型或资料可能改变运行条件，需要对应的变更与验证证据。也不应忽略仍在履责的接手人。回看“值守、告警、回退与变更”。
reason.en: Past handover is not permanent evidence for all versions. Model or source changes may alter operating conditions and need corresponding change/validation evidence, without erasing existing accountable owners. Revisit On-Call Coverage, Alerts, Rollback and Change.

questions.q: 模型文件交付后出现告警却无人响应，说明漏了什么？
questions.a: 落实负责人、运行手册、监测、故障接手、回退与变更维护
wrong: 再次复制模型文件作为完整交接

en.q: An alert has no responder after model-file delivery. What was missing?
en.a: Assign owners, runbooks, monitoring, incident takeover, rollback and change maintenance
wrong: Copy the model file again as a complete handover

questions.quote: List the runbook owner and publish it in a central location.

rationale.zh: 在业务情境中判断下一步，而非复述定义。
rationale.en: Judge the next action in context rather than recite a definition.

misconception.zh: 假设原试点质量与成本在所有规模都不变
misconception.en: Assume pilot quality and cost stay unchanged at any scale

title.zh: 性能、连续性、培训与支持

brief.zh: 先阅读本节全部基础知识卡，再逐项完成应用；本演练条件不代表通用评分或制度。整章交付后进入正式练习。
brief.en: Read all foundation cards in this section before applying them. Exercise conditions are not universal scores or policies. Enter formal practice after completing the chapter.

prompt.zh: 本演练新增地区，峰值容量、权限和支持成本尚未验证。下一步？
prompt.en: A new exercise region is planned; peak capacity, permissions and support costs are unverified. What next?

reason.zh: 规模变化会改变负载与条件，原假设需要重新验证；回看“性能、连续性、培训与支持”。
reason.en: Scale changes workload and conditions, so original assumptions need revalidation. Revisit Performance, continuity, training and support.

text.zh: 假设原试点质量与成本在所有规模都不变
text.en: Assume pilot quality and cost stay unchanged at any scale

text.zh: 重验容量、延迟、权限、培训、支持与连续性，按证据调节节奏
text.en: Revalidate capacity, latency, permissions, training, support and continuity and adjust pace by evidence

questions.q: 扩展到新地区时，为什么不能直接沿用原成本与质量结论？
questions.a: 新地区的负载、资料权限与支持条件可能不同，原质量和成本假设需要重新验证
wrong: 假设原试点质量与成本在所有规模都不变

en.q: Why cannot original quality and cost conclusions simply be reused in a new region?
en.a: Workload, data permissions and support conditions may differ in the new region, so prior quality and cost assumptions require revalidation
wrong: Assume pilot quality and cost stay unchanged at any scale

questions.quote: Load test your workload to verify it can handle production load and identify any performance bottleneck.
